title: CS2 Update Hides a New Frost Mechanic That Freezes Players and Weapons, and Snowy Cobblestone Looks Next
content:
Counter-Strike 2’s latest update looks like a routine fix on paper, but its files point to something much colder. Valve released the patch on 11 November with a short list of fixes for animations, Retakes bots and a DirectX 11 rendering hang. Underneath those notes, however, dataminers found a complete frost system that makes players, weapons and even chickens freeze when they stay outside, and thaw when they go indoors. Together with earlier finds pointing to a snowy version of Cobblestone, it is the clearest sign yet that Valve is preparing a winter map for CS2.

A showcase of how the new CS2 frost effect looks in game: pic.twitter.com/QrxANT5sde

The new console commands describe the mechanic in surprising detail. A command called r_csgo_frost_force switches the effect on and links it to players, weapons and chickens, with separate settings for outdoor and indoor areas. Two more control how quickly frost builds up outside and melts away indoors, and the files suggest that each takes about 10 seconds to reach its full state. In other words, a player who spends a round holding an open angle would gradually ice over, while one sitting in a building would stay clear.

Firing a weapon appears to be the main way to fight the cold. Another command sets how much a barrel heats up per shot, so a rifle that is being used constantly should resist frost while an idle one freezes over. The files also mention how long a burning Molotov takes to produce heat, which hints that fire could thaw players and weapons around it. Dataminer aqua, who tracks changes in CS2’s files, has already shown the effect running in the game , with a frosted weapon clearly visible in first person.

The update also adds a hidden video setting for parallax occlusion mapping, a rendering technique that gives flat surfaces convincing depth. Snow, with its footprints and uneven drifts, is exactly the kind of surface that benefits from it. None of this has been announced by Valve, and there is no release date. The commands could still change before launch, or end up limited to a single map or event rather than regular matchmaking.

Cobblestone is the obvious candidate for all of this. Earlier strings found in CS2’s files pointed to a snow-covered version of the map, with snowy textures and footprints, and the new frost system fits that theme perfectly. Cobblestone was part of CS:GO’s competitive map pool for years, so a winter return would bring back one of the game’s best-known layouts with a new twist. Snow maps are not new to the community either, as veteran mapper FMPONE showed when he released the Canadian Rockies map de_splinter earlier this year.

title: T1 brings TenZ out of retirement a day after re-signing crashies from Fnatic
content:
T1 has added two-time Masters champion Tyson 'TenZ' Ngo to its Valorant roster for VCT Pacific in 2027. The move ends his retirement and builds on T1's signing of crashies, who has just left London-based Fnatic.

T1 has ended Tyson ‘TenZ’ Ngo’s retirement. The organisation confirmed on 12 November that he will join its Valorant roster for VCT Pacific in 2027. It made the announcement with a post and a welcome video.

T1 called him a ‘living legend’ of Valorant. It said he was starting a new chapter with the organisation.

TenZ retired from professional play in 2024. He has spent this year at T1 as a content creator. The announcement moves him from that role into the competitive squad.

His record explains the attention. With Sentinels, he beat Fnatic 3-0 in the Masters Reykjavík 2021 final. He then won Masters Madrid 2024 with a 3-2 win over Gen.G. That made him the first Americas player to win more than one VCT Masters event, Liquipedia records.

The TenZ news came a day after T1 confirmed Austin ‘crashies’ Roberts. He returns six years after T1 released him in September 2020. crashies called T1 the place ‘where it all started’. He said he was excited for the new challenge.

title: 88% of Nvidia employees want Jensen Huang to stay, poll before second affair report
content:
Nearly nine in ten Nvidia employees want Jensen Huang to stay on as chief executive, according to a survey by the anonymous workplace app Blind . Of the 232 Nvidia staff who took part, 88% said Huang should remain in charge, 11% said he should step down voluntarily and just 1% said the board should remove him. The results spread quickly on 12 November, as Nvidia’s directors met to decide his future. They need one important caveat, however, because the poll was taken on 9 and 10 November, before the latest and most damaging report about him.

Blind lets users verify their employer through a work email address, which is why its polls are often treated as a rough guide to staff mood inside big tech companies. A wider Blind poll of 1,689 professionals across the industry was much less forgiving. Only 60% of those respondents wanted Huang to stay, 18% said he should leave voluntarily and 22% wanted the board to push him out . The gap suggests that the people closest to Huang judge him very differently from the rest of Silicon Valley.

A new statement from the independent members of the NVIDIA Board: https://t.co/uSFDhiohG8

When Nvidia staff answered the survey, the scandal was about one relationship. Huang had admitted to an affair in a letter to staff on 8 November, and US intelligence officials reportedly believe the woman involved, Alice Huang, was gathering information for China. The board had opened an investigation , but it had also said it had “no reason to believe” that national security or Nvidia’s secrets were compromised. Huang, meanwhile, had told staff he would cooperate fully.

The picture changed sharply on the afternoon of 11 November, when The New York Times reported that Huang had also had a relationship with a senior executive who reports to him, citing current and former employees. Within hours, the Wall Street Journal said the board was preparing to oust him, and Nvidia shares fell more than 8% in extended trading. A relationship with a direct report raises workplace and governance questions that the first affair did not, so the same employees might answer the Blind poll differently today.

Nvidia’s board had not announced a decision as of 07:30 UTC on 12 November. Its independent directors have already hired former Manhattan prosecutor Joon Kim and the law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to lead their inquiry. TalkEsport is not naming the executive in the Times report, who has not commented publicly and has not been accused of wrongdoing.

title: m0NESY Is the Only Esports Player in Forbes Russia’s 30 Most Valuable Athlete Brands
content:
Counter-Strike 2 player Ilya “m0NESY” Osipov has been ranked 14th in Forbes Russia’s list of the 30 most valuable personal brands among Russian athletes for 2026, published last week on 5 November. The Falcons rifler is the only esports player on the list. He climbed 10 places from 24th in the 2025 edition. Mixed martial arts fighter Islam Makhachev tops the 2026 ranking.

The Forbes Russia ranking measures the strength of an athlete’s personal brand rather than their earnings. It uses four weighted measures. Audience engagement on social media counts for 40% of the score. Audience size on social networking channels counts for 30%, social media popularity for 20% and media popularity for 10%.

Figure skaters Alexandra Trusova and Kamila Valieva also rank in the top three alongside Makhachev. Football goalkeeper Igor Akinfeev, footballer Matvey Kislyak and tennis player Andrey Rublev are all ranked below m0NESY. Forbes Russia has not published a monetary value for the brands. It has also not published the individual scores behind each position. Forbes Russia notes that esports stars trail even chess in mentions in professional media. However, it says their fan base and engagement can compete with those of figure skaters.

At 21, m0NESY is already one of the best-known players in Counter-Strike. He plays for Falcons, the reigning Major champions. He won the IEM Cologne Major 2026 with Falcons and was named the event’s most valuable player. Forbes Russia also lists five EVP awards, for exceptionally valuable player, among his achievements. Forbes Russia calls him “the biggest star of Russian esports”. He has earned more than $1m in prize money during his career.

He has featured in HLTV’s list of the top 20 players of the year in every year since his first full season with G2 in 2022. He finished second on the 2024 list, behind Danil “donk” Kryshkovets. Even donk, who beat him to HLTV’s top spot that year, does not appear on the Forbes Russia list. Falcons have stayed near the top this season, from their Esports World Cup 2026 opener to their ESL Pro League Season 24 run .

title: Nvidia Expands Its ElevenLabs Deal at the Summit Jensen Huang Skipped, Hours Before the Ouster Report
content:
Nvidia has deepened its partnership with ElevenLabs, the AI voice company, at the New York summit that Jensen Huang was supposed to headline. The chipmaker said on 11 November that its Nemotron models are now available inside ElevenAgents, ElevenLabs’ platform for building voice agents, in a post at 21:17 UTC , or 16:17 in New York. Kari Briski , one of Nvidia’s generative AI software leaders, represented the company on stage instead of its chief executive. Less than an hour later, The New York Times reported a second relationship involving Huang, and by the evening the Wall Street Journal said Nvidia’s board was preparing to remove him .

Huang had been booked for a fireside chat with ElevenLabs chief executive Mati Staniszewski. Business Insider reported on 9 November that his name had disappeared from the speaker list, a day after he admitted to an affair in a letter to staff. The agenda was then rewritten to give Staniszewski the closing keynote instead. Huang also stepped back from a separate gathering of chief executives this week, according to reports. The partnership went ahead without him, which says a lot about how Nvidia is trying to keep its business moving while its leadership is in question.

We’re expanding our collaboration with @elevenlabs to bring voice agents to enterprises and governments worldwide. With NVIDIA Nemotron models now in ElevenAgents, organizations have more choice in how they build and customize voice agents. NVIDIA’s @karibriski joined… pic.twitter.com/AJ0G8qQOpq

The centrepiece of the deal is Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, one of Nvidia’s open models, which ElevenLabs customers can now choose inside ElevenAgents. According to the ElevenLabs announcement , the model reached leading task-completion accuracy on the company’s customer-support benchmark at 70% lower cost than other leading open models. Its reasoning can also be switched off for simple tasks, which ElevenLabs says makes it one of the three fastest models on the platform. For businesses running thousands of calls a day, that combination of price and speed is the real selling point.

The bigger shift in this deal is about control over data. Companies can post-train Nemotron models on their own data and run the whole system on their own servers, rather than sending conversations to an outside cloud. That matters for banks, hospitals and governments, which often cannot let sensitive calls leave their own buildings. ElevenLabs is also adding 15 megawatts of Nvidia Vera Rubin computing capacity to its existing Blackwell Ultra systems, a sign of how much demand it expects.

The first public example comes from Poland, the home country of ElevenLabs’ co-founders. A voice agent running on-premises with Nvidia Confidential Computing will call patients who only have landlines, reminding them of appointments booked through the national e-Health system. That system handles about 40 million appointments a year, and ElevenLabs says missed appointments run between 10% and 20%. The two companies are also exploring voice AI that runs directly on robots, industrial machines and vehicles, although that work is still at an early stage.

title: Gen.G vs. BLG odds: Worlds 2026 finals betting and implied win chances
content:
Gen.G Esports are favorites over Bilibili Gaming (BLG) in the 2026 League of Legends (LoL) World Championship (Worlds) final on Nov. 14. Polymarket prices them at 63% to BLG’s 38%, while 1xBet and Stake imply about 61% to 62% once margin is removed.

These are the lines captured Nov. 12 . Decimal odds include your stake, so 1.55 returns 1.55 units for every unit wagered.

Each raw chance is 1 divided by the decimal odds. At 1xBet, 1 / 1.584 is 63.1% for Gen.G and 1 / 2.436 is 41.1% for BLG. Together they reach 104.2%, and the extra 4.2 points are the bookmaker’s margin.

Dividing each side by 104.2% removes the margin and leaves 60.6% for Gen.G and 39.4% for BLG. Stake’s raw figures are 64.5% and 40.0%, a total of 104.5%, which becomes 61.7% and 38.3%. This proportional method assumes the margin is spread evenly across both sides and may not be 100% reliable.

The same steps were used for Polymarket. 1 / 1.56 is 64.1% for Gen.G and 1 / 2.55 is 39.2% for BLG, a total of 103.3%. Removing the margin leaves 62.0% and 38.0%. The percent prices total 101%, which leaves 62.4% and 37.6%. It’s worth noting that when the numbers were captured, the platform displayed 63% for Gen.G .

Gen.G swept LYON 3-0 on Nov. 5 and Invictus Gaming 3-0 on Nov. 7, meaning they have not dropped a single game in the Worlds 2026 Knockout stage.

title: Tekken Veteran Katsuhiro Harada Asks Microsoft Never to Make Another Xbox Series S
content:
Katsuhiro Harada, the former director of the Tekken series, has said he wishes Microsoft had never released the Xbox Series S. He said he hoped hardware like it “wouldn’t be released” again. Harada made the comments on a developer panel at the 2026 Console Game Developers Conference in Seoul on 9 November. He said a senior Xbox official was in the audience at the time.

Harada said the Series S is a device “so similar” to the Xbox Series X but with “awkwardly lower performance”. He said developers must do extra work for it after finishing their main version. He compared the task to extra work for “a slightly weaker child”. He also said Series S players ask developers why texture quality is lower only on their console.

Harada led the Tekken fighting game series at Bandai Namco for more than two decades. He left the company at the end of 2025. He now heads VS Studio, a new studio under SNK, a long-time rival of Bandai Namco in fighting games. His comments carry weight because Tekken 8 was released on the Xbox Series X and Series S in 2024.

The panel was moderated by Shuhei Yoshida, a former PlayStation executive. Other speakers included Paweł Sasko, associate game director at CD Projekt Red, and DongKi Lee of Shift Up. Sasko disagreed with Harada. He said the Series S pushes developers to write cleaner code and brings players into gaming at a lower price. Harada said that was a polite way of saying the console was not good enough.

Harada contrasted the Series S with the Nintendo Switch 2. He said porting to the Switch 2 is different because it is its own device, rather than a weaker version of another console. The conference was organised by the Korea Creative Content Agency. The Xbox official Harada referred to has not been identified.

Microsoft launched the Xbox Series S on 10 November 2020 as a cheaper, digital-only option alongside the Series X. It was designed to run the same games as the Series X at lower resolutions. Microsoft generally requires games released on Series X to also run on Series S. Developers have raised the lower memory of the Series S as a challenge since its launch.

title: Cloud9 debuts in Deadlock with Melee Creeps signing
content:
American esports organization Cloud9 has entered the professional Deadlock space after signing the Melee Creeps roster. The squad flew their new banner at Deadlock Night Shift #64.

Cloud9 announced the acquisition on Nov. 9, 2026. This was a full pickup, meaning all six players plus the coach and managerial staff were absorbed into the org.

Greetings from the Cursed Apple The Melee Creeps are on Cloud9. pic.twitter.com/1spRSJzMcf

This Melee Creeps roster is considered one of the top squads on the Deadlock Night Shift (DLNS) weekly tournaments. They are regularly place within top three, and with the support of a big organization behind their back, these results can be expected to improve.

C9’s acquisition was divisive. Many took it as a good sign, and may encourage other top-of-the-table organizations to invest in Deadlock rosters. C9 was warmly welcomed into the space by the community, and it helps that they picked up already-prominent players.

On the other hand, eyebrows were raised on the sustainability of this choice. The only competitive Deadlock tournament right now are the weekly, regional Deadlock Night Shifts, and its prize pool is reliant on viewer donations . Some also pointed out the org’s choices in titles entered – with one in particular touching upon the fact that Cloud9 did not opt to enter the Marvel Rivals scene.

title: Wolves Esports to represent North America in $3 million PUBG Mobile world title
content:
PlayerUnknown’s Battlegrounds Mobile (PUBG Mobile) team Wolves Esports recently won this year’s PUBG Mobile Global Open (PMGO) Season 2 tournament. The players not only took home the lion’s share of $500,000, but also made esports history as North America’s first-ever PMGO winners. Wolves Esports players now set their sights on a $3 million world title at PUBG Mobile Global Championship 2026.

In addition to winning PMGO Season 2 and earning a place in this year’s PUBG Mobile Global Championship, Wolves Esports’ PUBG Mobile team achieved other notable victories throughout 2026. The team qualified for the Esports World Cup (EWC) over the summer. They also proved their worth at the 2026 PMGO Season 1 North America Finals and earned top placements in A-tier to B-tier tournaments throughout 2025.

PUBG Mobile Global Championship 2026 will happen in Istanbul, Türkiye from Nov. 26 to Dec. 13. The event will kick off with the Gauntlet Stage before the Group Stage. Then, a Last-Chance Qualifier (LCQ) will happen before the Grand Finals. Only 16 PUBG Mobile esports teams will make it all the way there to play 19 matches in total.

Wolves Esports will be among the teams duking it out in PUBG Mobile Global Championship 2026. Other top contenders in the Gauntlet Stage will be 18 Esports, 4K Esports, 4Thrives, AK Gold Esports, All Gamers, Aurora, Gaming Stars Esports, Hustler Crew, iKURD ESPORTS, NS RedForce, RoW Esports, S2G Esports, Sharper Esports, Team SouL, and The MongolZ.

Let's goooooooooo! #PUBGM | #PMGO pic.twitter.com/3T6ZGMDCZi

Happening between Nov. 26 and Nov. 27, the Gauntlet Stage will feature six matches a day. The top six teams will then advance to the Grand Finals. The remaining teams, meanwhile, will head to the Group Stage happening between Nov. 29 and Dec. 3. There, only the top three teams will earn spots in the Grand Finals. The rest will duke it out in the LCQ between Dec. 5 and Dec. 6 for three more spots.

title: This Viral Miami Street Video Is Actually GTA 6, and Rockstar Just Shared It
content:
A short clip of a Miami street has fooled a large part of the internet, because it is not Miami at all. The footage, posted on 11 November by the Miami-Dade content account ONLY in DADE with the hashtag #OnlyinViceCity, turned out to be Grand Theft Auto VI gameplay. Rockstar Games then shared the clip as a story on its official Instagram account and liked the original post, according to Kotaku. That was enough for most fans to accept it as real in-game footage, eight days before the game launches on 19 November.

Miami is officially a simulation. #OnlyinViceCity pic.twitter.com/wfJhm0frs3

The confusion came from where it was posted. ONLY in DADE mostly shares real street videos sent in by locals, so many viewers assumed the clip was another everyday Miami moment. One fan account’s version of the clip, posted at 19:23 UTC on 11 November, described it as possible new gameplay captured with an in-game phone camera. ONLY in DADE later posted it on X itself at 22:04 UTC, with the caption “Miami is officially a simulation”.

The clip appears to recreate a real promotional moment from last month, when Rockstar and West Coast Customs showed off custom cars on Miami’s streets. Side-by-side comparisons spread quickly, and one from the account NikTek, posted at 19:51 UTC , set the clip beside real Miami street footage. Its caption said the game was reaching “uncanny valley levels of realism”. Joel Franco, who covers internet culture, wrote that ONLY in DADE had told him it was actual gameplay , on top of Rockstar sharing it.

Real Life VS GTA 6 gameplay This game is reaching uncanny valley levels of realism pic.twitter.com/Y6ZZR5lGB2

The detail is what sells it, from the palm trees and parked cars to the pedestrians moving along the pavement. The camera angle helps too, because it looks like a phone recording rather than a polished trailer shot. Some fan accounts claimed the footage was captured with an in-game phone camera, but Rockstar has not said how it was recorded. Some viewers also thought they could see Jason and Lucia on the pavement, although that has not been confirmed either.

title: X Has a Hidden Screenshot Button on Android, and It Is Perfect for Saving Gaming News
content:
If you follow gaming news on X, there is now a cleaner way to save it. The X app for Android has a built-in Screenshot option in its share menu, which turns any post into a tidy image with an X watermark and no cropping needed. Many longtime users only found it on 11 November, and posts about the discovery flooded timelines so quickly that the backlash went viral too. One complaint about the trend, posted at 19:58 UTC , simply asked why the writer’s whole timeline was suddenly about one button.

For gamers, the timing is hard to beat. This is the week Rockstar is posting GTA 6 pre-load details, the VALORANT transfer window is running hot, and mobile players are counting down to PUBG Mobile Flash. Most of that news breaks on X first, before it reaches Discord servers, WhatsApp groups and Reddit threads as screenshots. The new option means those screenshots no longer need a phone’s status bar, battery icon or a notification cropped out first.

Latest X for Android 12.31 alpha.03 brought a new icon in post sharing sheet menu > Pressing it allows you to share a screenshot of the post (including quotes too) to save to gallery or copy to clipboard > This also has the X watermark pic.twitter.com/iplQitTiW7

The option does not need a separate setting, although it may only appear on recent versions of the X app for Android . Open the post you want to save and tap the Share icon underneath it. Scroll along the row of sharing options until you see Screenshot, then tap it to generate the image. You can then save the picture to your gallery or share it straight into a chat.

CID, an account that tracks unreleased app features, first spotted the option on 30 September, in X for Android version 12.31 alpha.03. The account said the option also captures quoted posts, which matters when a developer quotes a fan’s bug report or a leaker quotes an official teaser. It added that every image carries the X watermark and can be saved to the gallery or copied to the clipboard. X does not appear to have announced the feature formally, and TalkEsport could not find an official explanation of the rollout.

Gaming and esports news on X moves fast, and posts do not always stay up. Organisations announce signings and releases there first, as Sentinels chief executive Rob Moore did when he confirmed that cortezia and Reduxx were free agents this week. Developers post patch notes and performance details there too, like Rockstar’s pre-load announcement, whose 30fps target sparked the GTA 6 30fps backlash . A clean, saved copy is useful if a post is later edited or deleted.

title: The King ReturnZ: TenZ returns to competitive play with T1
TenZ Is Back: T1 Officially Signs the VALORANT Legend for VCT Pacific 2027
content:
TenZ is officially back in professional VALORANT, two years after he retired. T1 confirmed the signing of Tyson “TenZ” Ngo in a post at 03:00 UTC on 12 November , or 12:00 in Seoul, calling him “a living legend of VALORANT” and declaring that “the KING is back”. The Canadian star answered 11 minutes later with a two-word post of his own : “I’m back”. The move ends a retirement from pro play that began in September 2024, and puts one of the game’s most famous players in VCT Pacific for 2027.

𝐖𝐞𝐥𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞 '𝐓𝐞𝐧𝐙' The KING is back! A living legend of VALORANT, 'TenZ' begins a new chapter with T1. Ready to make history under the red wings, join us in giving him a warm welcome! https://t.co/ny3VtTtYnx #T1VALORANT pic.twitter.com/gmgLEzXJR2

The announcement confirms what we reported on 4 November, when reports first linked TenZ, crashies and Sacy with the Korean organisation. T1 announced crashies exactly a day earlier, at 03:00 UTC on 11 November, in a welcome post of its own. “Back where it all started,” crashies wrote, a reference to his first VALORANT team, which was T1 in 2020. Sacy’s reported move into the head coach role has not yet been confirmed by T1.

T1 is not a rebuilding team looking for a famous name to sell tickets. The club won Masters Bangkok in 2025, its first international VALORANT title, and finished third in Pacific Stage 2 and joint fifth at Champions in 2026. Its current roster on VLR.gg lists TenZ and crashies alongside three Korean players, stax, BuZz and iZu. That makes this a contender adding two proven internationals, rather than a project built from scratch around one star.

The commercial logic behind the signing is just as strong. TenZ has been one of VALORANT’s most recognisable faces since he led Sentinels to VCT Masters Reykjavík in 2021, where he was named grand final MVP. T1 is one of the biggest brands in esports, largely thanks to its League of Legends success, and it now has a VALORANT star with a huge following in North America. VCT Pacific matches are played in Seoul, so many of those fans will be watching their favourite player at very different hours from what they are used to.

There is a neat circle to the story as well. TenZ announced his retirement on 14 September 2024, shortly after Sentinels were knocked out of Champions 2024 in Seoul. Two years later, he returns to compete in the same city, this time wearing the colours of a Korean organisation. It also takes him into a region whose teams he mostly faced only at international events.

title: GTA 6 Pre-Loads Just Broke Virgin Media’s Broadband Records, Beating Arsenal and Fortnite
content:
GTA 6 pre-loads gave Virgin Media its busiest day on record, eight days before the game is even out. In a press release on 11 November , Virgin Media O2 said its UK broadband network set new highs for both peak traffic and total daily data on Tuesday 10 November. Peak traffic beat the previous record, set during Arsenal’s Champions League semi-final against Atlético Madrid, by 3.8%. Total data for the day was 4% higher than the previous best, which was set only on 1 November by the launch of Fortnite’s Chapter 7 Mini Season.

The rush started as soon as downloads opened. Between midnight and 1am UK time on 10 November, which is also midnight to 1am UTC in winter, Virgin Media recorded a 51.6% rise in broadband traffic compared with the same hour a week earlier. By 9am, the total data downloaded was 73.3% higher than over the same period on Tuesday 3 November. At 23:05 UTC, the network passed its previous record for an entire day’s data, with almost an hour of Tuesday still to go. Virgin Media O2 did not say how many customers pre-loaded the game, or publish its peak traffic in terabits per second.

Grand Theft Auto VI pre-loading is now available for everyone who has pre-ordered. If you still have yet to pre-order, now’s the time to make sure you're prepared for November 19: https://t.co/LUoPLobocD pic.twitter.com/TLtJUSFBwN

Virgin Media puts the game at 190GB, slightly less than the 212GB of free space we reported in our GTA 6 pre-load guide . The company says customers on its fastest Gig2 broadband service can download it in under 15 minutes. Our own calculation, at full line speed with no overheads, gives just under 13 minutes on a 2Gbps connection. On a 100Mbps line, the same download would take more than four hours, so many players will want to start well before launch day.

Pre-loading was always likely to strain networks, given how many people have already bought the game. GTA 6 has become the most pre-ordered game on record, with an estimated 9.69 million pre-orders, according to Sensor Tower. Rockstar’s own pre-load announcement also confirmed that the game targets 30 frames per second on consoles, which has caused a backlash among players . That debate has done little to slow the downloads, judging by Virgin Media’s figures.

Virgin Media O2 also published polling from Strand Partners, a member of the British Polling Council , which surveyed 520 UK adults who expect to play the game on 30 October. Nearly half (46%) said they expect to download GTA 6 before release day, and 45% expect to spend at least £50 on gaming kit, not counting the game. More than three-quarters (78%) have changed, or plan to change, their schedules to find time to play. Almost a quarter (23%) expect to stay up later or sleep less, and 22% plan to keep a whole weekend free.

title: Best Permanent Unlocks to spend Tokens on in Modern Warfare 4
content:
Classic Prestige has returned in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, and that means that Permanent Unlock Tokens are coming back as well. If you’re unfamiliar with how Prestige Mode works, it resets your level back to one, but you receive a Permanent Unlock Token that you can use on any class item in multiplayer in exchange.

This is a huge benefit, as it lets you permanently unlock an item so you never have to unlock it again during the entire Prestige grind in Modern Warfare 4 . However, with so many items to choose from, which unlock gives you the best bang for your buck?

Below, we’ll give you five distinct class items in MW4 multiplayer that are most worth spending a Permanent Unlock Token on after you Prestige. The item list is in order from 1-5.

First on the list has to be the Stim, which is a piece of Tactical Equipment that quickly heals you back to full health when applied. The Stim is unlocked at level 47 in MW4 multiplayer, making it one of the final items you’ll unlock every single Prestige.

While there are other solid pieces of Tactical Equipment you can use until that level, once you get used to the Stim, there’s really no going back. The ability to get back into the fight instantly after being injured, compared to waiting for several seconds to recoup health, is one of the most important benefits of any item in multiplayer. If you use a Permanent Unlock Token on the Stim, your Tactical slot is pretty much set in stone on all loadouts in multiplayer.

Next up, we have the Axion assault rifle, which is unlocked at level 52. The Axion is one of the best assault rifles in Modern Warfare 4, and having it available for only three levels every Prestige is ultimately a waste of its potential. This is arguably a top meta weapon in multiplayer, so you’ll want it permanently unlocked as soon as possible.

title: How to get Ledge Hanging Kills in Modern Warfare 4
content:
Plenty of weapon camo challenges have become a pain in the sides of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 players everywhere, but none more than earning Ledge Hanging Kills. You need these kills specifically to unlock a camo for the Krait P68 pistol, and even though you only need 15 of them, it can feel like this challenge is impossible in multiplayer.

Fortunately, thanks to the release of some post-launch content in MW4, Ledge Hanging Kills aren’t an issue at all. So, if you want to see exactly how to earn Ledge Hanging Kills quickly, check out the guide below.

Ledge Hanging Kills require you to mantle halfway up an object, hang in the air, and then use your gun in a single hand to kill enemies. This is extremely difficult on its own, as there really aren’t that many objects that can be ledge-hung from on multiplayer maps in MW4.

However, there is one major exception to this rule. On the map Shipment, there are some red crates on the side of the map near the wooden pallets and ruined car. On either side of these red crates, you can jump up to the middle ledge and hang from it. You can see us performing the ledge hang from the red crate in the screenshot below.

From this position, you need to wait for enemies to come around the corner in front of you or from the crate’s exit right below you. Either way, you’ll be able to kill them fairly easily from this position, as no enemy expects you to be hanging off the side of the crate.

Of course, once you get a kill in this position, enemies will likely hunt you down, so it’s wise to move to different sides of the red crate to cause some confusion. In any case, though, you now have a bona fide spot to earn your Ledge Hanging Kills in Modern Warfare 4.

title: How to win this week’s Hearthstone Tavern Brawl: The Dark Wanderer decks and guide
content:
Diablo has entered this week’s Hearthstone Tavern Brawl. Defeating him results in a free card pack and, if you haven’t already completed this Tavern Brawl in the past, the Secret Level card back. Here’s our guide on how to claim victory plus some The Dark Wanderer decks and deck codes.

The Dark Wanderer is a Tavern Brawl that requires you to build your own deck. Since this game mode is under the Wild format, you don’t have to only use Standard cards. When you first jump into the fray, you must face The Dark Wanderer. After getting his 50 health down to 0, he gets replaced by Diablo. This time, your opponent has 150 health.

It can feel devastating when you see Diablo after a hard-fought victory against The Dark Wanderer. It may even feel impossible as you must begin the Diablo fight with double the damage to your face.

However, what’s nice about this Tavern Brawl is that you can chip away at Diablo’s health in multiple matches. For example, after we defeated The Dark Wanderer with our Dead Man’s Hand Warrior deck, we started another match with our Mech Paladin one. This match resulted in Diablo having 123 health left, as seen in our screenshot below.

We then alternated between Face Hunter and a makeshift Mage deck full of spells to the face to achieve lethal faster. Eventually, Diablo’s health went down to 0, granting us a free Reign of the Black Empire card pack.

As noted, we used Dead Man’s Hand Warrior to defeat The Dark Wanderer and then fought Diablo with Face Hunter, Mech Paladin, and a Mage deck loaded with spells to the face. We chose the first three decks simply because we enjoy piloting them and already have all the cards in our collection.

title: Gentle Mates a refusé une place en LEC
content:
Et si Gentle Mates avait rejoint le LEC ? Alors que la structure française s’est retirée de League of Legends fin 2025, Gotaga a fait une révélation inattendue lors d’un récent stream. Le club fondé avec Squeezie et Brawks aurait pu accéder directement à l’élite européenne, sans passer par les résultats sportifs.

« On nous a proposé un jour de rejoindre Gentlemates et d’avoir un spot LEC. Mais ce qui allait avec, c’était pas raccord avec beaucoup de choses […] » , a expliqué le streamer et CEO de la structure. Une opportunité finalement écartée, Gentle Mates ayant préféré préserver son indépendance plutôt que d’accepter les conditions de l’opération.

Lancée en 2023, Gentle Mates avait fait ses premiers pas sur League of Legends en LFL lors de la saison 2024. Malgré deux qualifications aux EMEA Masters, au printemps 2024 puis à l’été 2025, la structure n’était jamais parvenue à s’imposer durablement parmi les meilleures équipes françaises.

En novembre 2025, le club avait finalement annoncé la fermeture de sa division LoL, après deux saisons compliquées. Cette révélation de Gotaga donne aujourd’hui un nouvel éclairage sur ses ambitions passées. Si Gentle Mates a eu l’occasion de rejoindre le LEC, l’identité de l’interlocuteur, la date précise et les modalités de la proposition restent inconnues. De quoi nourrir quelques regrets chez les supporters, qui auraient sans doute aimé voir leur équipe affronter les cadors européens.

title: VCT EMEA : Vitality officialise jawgemo pour 2027
content:
Après plusieurs semaines de rumeurs, Team Vitality tient sa nouvelle star. La structure française a confirmé l’arrivée d’Alexander « jawgemo » Mor, duelliste américano-cambodgien qui évoluait jusqu’ici chez G2 Esports. Avec jawgemo, Vitality dispose désormais de son effectif pour la saison 2027 et pourra aborder le prochain cycle du VCT EMEA avec de grandes ambitions. Pour sa première expérience sur le circuit européen, l’ancien champion du monde tentera d’apporter son expérience et sa capacité à briller dans les grands matchs. L’objectif est clair pour la Ruche : retrouver les sommets internationaux et, cette fois, décrocher le titre mondial qui lui a échappé en 2026.

title: LEC : Carzzy bientôt de retour chez KOI ?
content:
Le mercato continue de s’agiter en LEC, et Movistar KOI pourrait bien réaliser un joli coup. Selon les informations du média espagnol Esportmaniacos , Matyáš « Carzzy » Orság serait actuellement la cible numéro un de la structure espagnole pour remplacer Supa au poste d’AD Carry. En fin de contrat avec Vitality, le Tchèque de 24 ans serait déjà en discussion avec les dirigeants de KOI. Une opération qui marquerait son troisième passage au sein de cette organisation, après ses précédentes expériences sous les couleurs de MAD Lions.

Ce possible transfert intervient après une année particulièrement frustrante pour Carzzy et Vitality. Malgré des performances encourageantes en saison régulière, avec notamment une première place au Spring Split (8-1) et une deuxième au Summer Split, les Abeilles n’ont remporté aucun BO5 en 2026. Cinq défaites consécutives dans cet exercice ont finalement précipité une importante reconstruction, avec le départ du staff technique et plusieurs changements attendus dans l’effectif. Libre de s’engager ailleurs à l’expiration de son contrat, Carzzy pourrait donc saisir cette occasion pour relancer sa carrière.

De son côté, Movistar KOI sort également d’une saison contrastée. Troisième du LEC Versus et du Spring Split, puis finaliste du Summer Split face à G2 Esports, la formation espagnole n’a pas réussi à décrocher le moindre titre. Aux Worlds 2026, Elyoya et ses coéquipiers ont notamment signé une victoire de prestige face à Bilibili Gaming, futur finaliste de la compétition, avant de tomber contre la Karmine Corp (0-2) lors du dernier tour du Swiss Stage. Une élimination aux portes des quarts de finale qui semble avoir convaincu les dirigeants de renforcer leur effectif.

Et Carzzy pourrait ne pas être la seule recrue de prestige. Selon les dernières informations de Sheep Esports , BrokenBlade aurait déjà trouvé un accord verbal avec Movistar KOI pour remplacer Myrwn sur la toplane, après cinq années passées chez G2. La structure espagnole conserverait en parallèle son noyau dur composé d’Elyoya, Jojopyun et Alvaro. Si les différentes opérations se concrétisent, KOI disposerait d’un cinq particulièrement expérimenté pour tenter de détrôner G2 et la Karmine Corp en 2027. Reste désormais à savoir si les négociations avec Carzzy aboutiront à un accord définitif.

Despite still being only 19, the duellist took responsibility for the team's results in 2026 and described the stretch as a foundation he'll personally build on. title: Reinstated Aurora Gaming beat F9 EICAR to win Valorant Europe Qualifier 1
content:
Aurora Gaming came from a map down to beat F9 EICAR 2-1 and win the first VCT EMEA Kickoff Europe open qualifier. The win came days after they were put back into the bracket when the UK team BONK was disqualified for cheating.

The VCT EMEA Kickoff: Europe Qualifier 2027 decider got under way at 18:45. The series began on Lotus. Aurora’s chiwa was named most valuable player of the series.

The Aurora roster lists Boo, chiwa, Derke, B1SK and trexx. F9 EICAR, based in France, fielded Kipperman, Destrian, Tenshi, izana and Geekkooo.

Aurora’s run nearly ended early. BONK, a UK Valorant roster, beat them 2-1 in the round of 32 on 6 November. That result followed a comeback from 3-11 down on Bind. Riot’s ruling against BONK reversed Aurora’s exit. Every BONK player and registered team member was provisionally suspended. Project 100K and ycatble returned to the bracket along with Aurora.

The qualifier left no room for error. It was a single-elimination bracket for 256 teams, and every match was a best-of-three. Once reinstated, Aurora did not drop a map before the final. They beat Pixel Lumina 2-0 in the second semi-final.

In the first semi-final, xXxMasterProMegaTeamxXx fell 2-1 to F9 EICAR. The French side had arrived at the qualifier in mixed form. F9 EICAR lost 0-2 to WIP Esports in VCL France: Revolution Stage 2 2026 and were twice beaten 1-2 by Mandatory. A 2-1 result against Esprit Shōnen was their only victory in that run.

title: Nvidia Cancels 24GB RTX 5080 as Memory Costs Rise, Report Says
content:
Nvidia has cancelled a planned 24GB version of its GeForce RTX 5080 graphics card. The card would have carried 8GB more video memory than the existing 16GB RTX 5080. Reports circulating on Chinese message boards remain unverified, with Nvidia yet to issue an official confirmation or denial.

The 24GB card was intended to become Nvidia’s flagship graphics card for the Chinese market, according to VideoCardz . The report said the cancellation was linked to the cost of GDDR7 memory, the type of video memory the card uses. VideoCardz also linked the issue to delays affecting a GeForce RTX 5080 Super. Nvidia has not announced either product, and it has not said whether an RTX 5080 Super is still planned.

The existing RTX 5080 uses eight 2GB GDDR7 memory chips, giving it 16GB in total. The 24GB version would have used eight 3GB chips instead. The 3GB chips cost about three times as much as the 2GB chips, according to the report. VideoCardz reported that Nvidia will continue to supply graphics processors paired with 2GB chips. That would allow its partner manufacturers to keep making the 16GB card.

Earlier reports had suggested the 24GB card could arrive in December 2026 or January 2027, and could replace the 16GB model in China. Nvidia never confirmed those reports. The company has not said how many RTX 5080 cards it plans to supply in the coming months, or whether prices will change.

The report comes as memory prices have risen across the hardware industry. Demand from companies building artificial intelligence data centres has increased competition for memory chips. Several gaming devices have had price rises this year, including the PlayStation 5, Xbox Series consoles, Nintendo Switch 2, ROG Ally and Valve’s Steam Deck. Nintendo has said it is not considering another Switch 2 price rise, as we covered in our report on Nintendo’s latest earnings .

Nvidia is also facing questions over its leadership following reports of an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang. The development comes after Huang reportedly disclosed an extramarital affair to employees on November 8. We previously covered the developments surrounding the inquiry in our report on Huang’s return to the office and apology to executives . Nvidia has not linked that inquiry to its product plans, and it has not commented on the VideoCardz report. US House members have asked Huang to testify before Congress on 18 November.

title: Weibo Gaming’s Suk Hints at Retirement After PEL Final and PMGC 2026
content:
Weibo Gaming’s Feng “Suk” Shujie has said he may only play two more tournaments before stepping away from PUBG Mobile. He named the final of China’s Peacekeeper Elite League (PEL) and the PUBG Mobile Global Championship (PMGC) 2026 as his last events. He also said he does not plan to renew his contract next year.

The graphic is titled “My Last Ride” and carries the PUBG Mobile Esports logo. It shows an English translation of comments by Suk. TalkEsport has not been able to verify the original Chinese remarks or the accuracy of the translation. Neither Suk nor Weibo Gaming has publicly confirmed a retirement.

In the translated comments, Suk said he can “only play this last PEL final” and the PMGC at the end of the year. He said he does “not want to renew” his contract next year. He also said he was “not even sure” he would be able to compete at the PMGC. Suk said the game itself was not the reason. He said he was “too miserable” in his current environment, and that the cause was not a lack of rest.

Suk is a 28-year-old Chinese player, born on 3 September 1998. He has played for Weibo Gaming since 12 January 2023. He previously played for EDward Gaming, Four Angry Men, The Chosen and Titan Esports Club. In the translated comments, he said he had “persevered for eight years”, which matches the start of his professional career in 2018.

Suk was named finals MVP at the PUBG Mobile Global Championship 2020, where Four Angry Men finished second, according to Liquipedia. He won the PEL 2020 Season 3 title with the same team. With Weibo Gaming, he finished second at the PUBG Mobile World Cup 2025 and won the PUBG Mobile Hong Kong Invitational 2025. Liquipedia lists his career earnings at about $1.04m.

Weibo Gaming finished second in both the PEL Spring 2026 and Summer 2026 finals, according to Liquipedia. The team has not won a PMGC title with Suk on the roster. In the translated comments, Suk referred to fans asking whether he could “go fight for his dream” one more time and win a PMGC.

title: MOUZ face elimination against FUT four days after their Beijing title
content:
The world number one have to beat the team that knocked them out of the Cologne Major, and FUT have won the last four meetings between the two.

Four days is all it took for MOUZ to go from champions to a must-win match. On Sunday they lifted the IEM Beijing trophy without dropping a map . On Wednesday they lost 2-1 to G2 , a team that had lost six series in a row. Now MOUZ meet FUT Esports in the Group B elimination match at BLAST Rivals 2026 Season 2 on Thursday 08:00 CET . The loser finishes fourth in the group and goes home. The winner goes to Friday’s quarter-finals.

MOUZ arrived in Hong Kong as the number one team on both the HLTV ranking and Valve’s VRS, and the start looked normal. They took Nuke 13-7, which stretched their run to 14 straight map wins going back to PGL Masters Bucharest .

The series turned on Ancient. MOUZ came back from 1-5 to lead 12-8 and needed one more round. G2 won the next four to force overtime and took overtime 4-2, with r1nkle finishing the map 31-18. On Inferno, G2 won the first five rounds and MOUZ never caught up.

Ancient is the map to watch on Thursday. FUT have played it against MOUZ three times this year and won all three (see the table below).

On paper this is the world’s best team against an opponent that played Wednesday without its in-game leader. The head-to-head tells a different story. Since February, FUT have won four of their five meetings with MOUZ, and the last four in a row.

title: Las Vegas approves $2 million BLAST deal for a 2028 Major
content:
The city’s tourism board passed the sponsorship without a single question, but Valve has still not named any 2028 Major host.

The Las Vegas Convention and Visitors Authority (LVCVA) board approved a $2 million sponsorship agreement with BLAST ApS on Tuesday 10 November, covering a Counter-Strike Major and a summer BLAST event in Las Vegas in 2028. The vote was first reported by LVSportsBiz , which noted that board members had no questions for staff on the item, and the Las Vegas Review-Journal also reported the approval.

On Monday we wrote that Las Vegas was weighing the $2 million BLAST deal ahead of the meeting.

LVCVA chief sports officer Janis Burke told the board that the dates were the selling point, the Review-Journal reported:

What’s particularly attractive about this opportunity is the timing. The Counter-Strike Major will take place between Thanksgiving and National Finals Rodeo, a typically low-demand period within our destination. And the second event will be selected specifically to drive visitation over a low-demand summer weekend in 2028.

HLTV reported that the second Major of 2028 is tentatively pencilled in for 20 November to 10 December. The summer event will be held at the Las Vegas Convention Center, and the board documents do not name the game.

title: VCT EMEA : aspas, dernière pièce du puzzle FUT Esports
content:
Le mercato continue de réserver son lot de surprises sur VALORANT. Selon les informations de THESPIKE.GG , confirmées par Sheep Esports , Erick « aspas » Santos aurait trouvé un accord verbal avec FUT Esports pour la saison 2027. La superstar brésilienne, actuellement chez MIBR, s’apprêterait ainsi à quitter le continent américain pour découvrir le championnat EMEA. Un transfert retentissant pour l’un des duellistes les plus redoutés de la scène internationale, dont l’avenir alimentait les rumeurs depuis plusieurs semaines.

Pourtant, d’autres destinations étaient envisagées par le joueur. Aspas aurait notamment reçu des propositions particulièrement lucratives en provenance de Chine, un championnat qu’il aimerait découvrir au cours de sa carrière. Mais le Brésilien aurait finalement privilégié le projet sportif de FUT Esports, jugé plus intéressant sur le plan compétitif. Après une saison 2026 décevante avec MIBR, marquée par une absence totale des tournois internationaux, l’ancien champion du monde entend retrouver les sommets.

Avec cette potentielle signature, FUT Esports confirme ses immenses ambitions pour 2027. La structure turque a déjà officialisé l’arrivée de Wo0t, ancien joueur de Team Heretics, ainsi que la prolongation de yetujey. Deux autres recrues seraient également attendues : hezacoil et batujnax, qui auraient trouvé un accord avec l’organisation. L’arrivée d’aspas viendrait donc compléter un cinq particulièrement prometteur, mêlant expérience internationale et jeunes talents turcs.

Ce recrutement pourrait également marquer un tournant dans la carrière du Brésilien. Considéré depuis plusieurs années comme une référence mondiale à son poste, aspas reste sur l’un des exercices les plus compliqués de son parcours. Malgré des performances individuelles toujours solides, il n’a pas réussi à qualifier MIBR pour le moindre événement international en 2026, manquant notamment les Champions pour la première fois de sa carrière professionnelle.

L’objectif sera désormais de retrouver les premiers rôles avec FUT Esports, qui fait partie des huit équipes partenaires du VCT EMEA pour les saisons 2027 et 2028. Face à une concurrence particulièrement relevée, notamment Fnatic, Gentle Mates, Vitality, Team Liquid et Heretics, la structure turque semble déterminée à décrocher son premier grand titre. Avec Wo0t et aspas dans la même équipe, FUT pourrait bien devenir l’un des principaux favoris du championnat européen.

title: G2 upset MOUZ 2-1 to end six straight series defeats
content:
r1nkle went 31-18 as G2 came back from 8-12 on Ancient, before MATYS and NertZ carried them through Inferno.

Coming into Hong Kong, G2 had lost six series in a row and had gone out of three straight events without a series win. MOUZ had not dropped a map since PGL Masters Bucharest. On Wednesday, the clear underdogs beat the IEM Beijing champions. G2 Esports beat MOUZ 2-1 (Nuke 7-13, Ancient 16-14, Inferno 13-7) in Group B of BLAST Rivals 2026 Season 2 . That puts them one win from the semi-finals.

NEVER STOP BELIEVING 🥹 pic.twitter.com/2fMtbUDOOs

The opening map gave little hint of what was coming. Nuke used to be G2’s permaban. This season they have let it into their pool, and MOUZ picked it straight away. G2 levelled the first half at 6-6 after taking an M4 off MOUZ in a force-buy. On the CT side MOUZ then won seven of the last eight rounds, and xertioN closed the map with a quad kill. Lotan “Spinx” Giladi went 19-8. NertZ finished with three kills in 20 rounds and 34.0 ADR.

Ancient was G2’s pick, and it decided the series. G2 won the pistol round and led 5-1 on the T side, but MOUZ hit back with a string of 1vX rounds, including a 1v3 from xelex, and went 12-8 up. G2 won the next four rounds to force overtime, then took it 4-2.

Artem “r1nkle” Moroz finished Ancient 31-18 with 93.3% KAST and won the last round. He joined G2 as their AWPer in June, and his numbers since then have been at the centre of the criticism of the team. NertZ, so quiet on Nuke, added 26-20. The defeat ended a run of 14 straight map wins for MOUZ, stretching back to Bucharest.

title: Snax Becomes Most Watched BGMI Streamer in the Last 30 Days
content:
Renowned S8UL content creator and former esports athlete Raj “Snax” Varma has become the most watched Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI) streamer over the 30 day period ending on 11th November. Snax has beaten all other major streamers, including LoLzZz Gaming and Jonathan Gaming, and even Krafton India Esports in the last 30 days.

According to LetsGrowEsports’ livestream analytics platform, Snax Gaming has emerged as the most watched BGMI streamer in the past 30 days. Notably, he has topped the charts for both Hours Watched and Peak Viewers, beating even Krafton India Esports despite two official events, Battlegrounds Mobile India Showdown 2026 (BMSD 2026) and Battlegrounds Mobile India International Cup 2026 (BMIC 2026), taking place in the same timeframe.

Over the last 30 days, Snax has recorded a whopping 1.84 million watch hours, trailed by Krafton India Esports and LoLzZz Gaming at 1.47 million watch hours and 363 thousand watch hours, respectively. What stands out is that the difference between Snax and LoLzZz (#3) is over five times.

Now, if we turn towards peak viewership, a similar trend follows. Snax leads the chart with a massive 247.6k peak concurrent viewers, followed by Krafton India Esports and Jonathan Gaming with 185.5k and 115.2k peak viewers, respectively. Interestingly, Snax’s peak viewership was more than twice that of Jonathan Gaming (#3).

Snax’s content creation and livestreaming journey has been going extremely well for the past few months. Notably, during his PUBG Mobile World Cup watch party at Esports World Cup GRAND FINALS, he recorded a concurrent peak viewership of a massive 448540 viewers . To put it into perspective, only 2 livestreams have recorded a concurrent peak viewership higher than his. The first being Akın Batur at 706680 peak concurrent viewers and PUBG Mobile Indonesia at 472164 peak concurrent viewers.

title: Bilibili Gaming sign world champion Smoggy from EDG
content:
The controller from EDward Gaming’s 2024 title side ends more than four years at the club and joins a BLG team that missed Champions Shanghai and is still looking for a head coach.

Bilibili Gaming have signed Zhang “Smoggy” Zhao for the 2027 VCT season. EDward Gaming announced on Weibo on Tuesday 10 November that he was leaving the team with immediate effect, and BLG confirmed his arrival on Wednesday 11 November.

Sheep Esports reported the move on 5 November, as we noted in our round-up of the China offseason .

Smoggy came to EDG from Weibo Gaming in July 2022, and EDG’s farewell post recalls that his first appearance came as a substitute at Champions Istanbul that year. He started out in a flex role, covering initiator, sentinel and secondary duelist around ZmjjKK, before moving to primary controller midway through 2024, VLR.gg writes.

The switch paid off within months. EDG won China Kickoff, Stage 1 and Stage 2 in 2024 and then became the first Chinese team to win VALORANT Champions , beating Team Heretics 3-2 in the Seoul final.

Under head coach Autumn in 2026, EDG won China Stage 1 and finished third in London, but Champions Shanghai ended in the group stage. All four Chinese teams went out there without winning a series.

title: BGMI Air Pre Registration Opens on iOS Ahead of 10 December Launch
content:
KRAFTON India has opened pre-registration for BGMI Air on iOS, a month before the game launches in India on 10 December. iPhone users can now sign up on the Apple App Store, the company said on 11 November. Until now, pre-registration had been open only on Google Play, where it passed 14 million sign-ups. The iOS opening means players on both major mobile platforms can now register before launch.

BGMI Air is a lighter version of Battlegrounds Mobile India, KRAFTON India’s main battle royale game. The company says it keeps BGMI’s core gameplay while needing an initial download of around 1GB. That size is aimed at players whose phones or storage have kept them from playing BGMI. KRAFTON India has not published the minimum device requirements or the full install size after updates. The small download is the main way the company hopes to reach players who cannot run the full game.

BGMI Air will be a separate app rather than an update to BGMI. Existing BGMI players can play it without transferring their current accounts, KRAFTON India said. The company has not said whether progress, purchases or cosmetics will carry over between the two games. It has also not said whether players on the two apps will share matchmaking. For existing players, this means BGMI Air is an extra app, not a replacement.

The Android figure gives a sense of early demand. BGMI Air passed 14 million pre-registrations on Google Play before its launch date was announced, the company said. That is about 5% of BGMI’s 260 million total downloads, a TalkEsport calculation. The comparison is rough, because downloads and pre-registrations measure different things, and one person can count more than once. Even so, the figure shows the lighter app has drawn substantial interest before release.

KRAFTON India has not said how many players it expects at launch, or whether esports events will follow. Karan Pathak, KRAFTON India’s associate director of esports, said the company would launch the app first and then decide its esports plans, as we covered in our interview with Karan Pathak . TalkEsport reported earlier on how BGMI Air passed 10 million pre-registrations , and on the confirmation of its launch date . Any esports announcement is therefore unlikely before the app is available.

Players can pre-register now on Google Play and the Apple App Store. KRAFTON India said further updates will come through BGMI Air’s official social media accounts. Everything confirmed so far is in our BGMI Air guide , and details on the main game are on the official BGMI website . BGMI Air launches in India on 10 December.

title: GTA 6 Pre-Orders Near 10 Million, and PS5 Is Crushing Xbox
content:
Grand Theft Auto 6 has taken close to 10 million pre-orders, according to Sensor Tower, and three in four of them are on PS5. Xbox Series X|S holds the other quarter ahead of the November 19 launch.

Research firm Sensor Tower has updated its GTA 6 sales tracker. It now counts 9.69 million pre-purchases, worth about $942 million in gross revenue. These are estimates. Neither Rockstar nor Take-Two has published a pre-order total.

At that level, the game is already past the 8 million pre-order mark linked to Cyberpunk 2077, the previous record.

PS5 accounts for 7.23 million of those pre-orders. Xbox Series X|S accounts for 2.46 million. That is a 75% to 25% split in favor of PlayStation.

Revenue follows the same pattern. PS5 pre-orders have brought in $703 million. Xbox Series X|S pre-orders have brought in $239 million.

Sony and Microsoft each keep about 30% of that money in platform fees. Both companies gain from the game's success, whatever the split.

title: Spirit recover from a 13-0 on Nuke to beat FUT 2-1
content:
FUT, with coach coolio in for Krabeni, won Spirit’s own Nuke pick 13-0 before donk and tN1R went 45-16 on Ancient.

Spirit’s T side on Nuke had won 59% of its rounds over the last three months, the best record in the world. On Wednesday it won none. Team Spirit lost their own map pick 13-0 to a FUT Esports side playing with their coach, and still came through 2-1 (Cache 13-9, Nuke 0-13, Ancient 13-5) to secure a playoff place at BLAST Rivals 2026 Season 2 in Hong Kong.

title: LEC : Shifters pourrait céder sa place à une nouvelle équipe en 2027
content:
Et si Shifters disparaissait du LEC dès la saison prochaine ? Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , l’organisation suisse étudierait actuellement la possibilité de louer sa place dans le championnat européen de League of Legends. Plusieurs structures esportives, notamment issues des ligues régionales (ERL), auraient déjà été approchées par mail pour évaluer leur intérêt. Une opération qui rappellerait l’arrivée de la Karmine Corp en LEC, mais qui nécessiterait obligatoirement l’approbation de Riot Games.

Pour l’instant, aucun accord n’a été confirmé et Shifters pourrait tout à fait conserver sa place en 2027. Mais le calendrier commence à devenir préoccupant. Alors que la plupart des équipes européennes s’activent sur le mercato, la structure suisse n’aurait encore entamé aucune véritable démarche pour reconstruire son effectif. Aucun joueur ne serait actuellement engagé pour la saison prochaine, même verbalement. D’après la base de données officielle des contrats de Riot Games, tous les engagements de l’effectif actuel arrivent à expiration au plus tard le 16 novembre.

Cette réflexion intervient après une année particulièrement compliquée sur le plan sportif. Anciennement connue sous le nom de Team BDS, Shifters espérait ouvrir un nouveau chapitre de son histoire avec son changement d’identité. Mais les résultats n’ont jamais suivi. Malgré plusieurs ajustements dans l’effectif, l’équipe a terminé deux fois à la dixième place et une fois au neuvième rang lors des trois segments du LEC 2026. Un bilan très loin des ambitions affichées par la structure.

Ces difficultés ont également provoqué plusieurs départs importants. Le midlaner français nuc et le support Stend ont tous les deux annoncé prendre du recul avec la compétition, tandis que l’entraîneur principal Striker avait lui aussi évoqué la possibilité de faire une pause. À ces problèmes sportifs s’ajoutent les nombreux bouleversements internes traversés par l’organisation depuis le départ de son fondateur, Patrice Bailo de Spoelberch, et l’abandon du nom Team BDS.

Arrivée dans l’élite européenne en 2022 après le retrait de Schalke 04, la structure suisse pourrait donc tourner une page importante de son histoire. Pour autant, les raisons exactes de cette éventuelle mise en location restent inconnues. Si les difficultés sportives ont pu peser dans la réflexion, rien ne permet actuellement d’affirmer que Shifters traverse une crise financière. Sheep Esports précise également ne pas avoir pu identifier d’organisation engagée dans des négociations avancées.

Reste désormais à savoir si cette piste se concrétisera dans les prochaines semaines. Pour une structure ambitieuse évoluant actuellement en ligue régionale, récupérer temporairement une place en LEC représenterait une opportunité majeure d’accéder au plus haut niveau européen. Une chose est certaine : l’avenir de Shifters est plus incertain que jamais, et le Summer Split 2026 pourrait bien avoir été sa dernière apparition sous ce nom dans le championnat.

title: SouL Goblin Gives Update on Team SouL’s PMGC 2026 Visa Status
content:
Team SouL’s visas for the PUBG Mobile Global Championship (PMGC) 2026 have not been completed yet. Goblin, who plays for SouL, shared the update himself, saying the process is still going on and that he hopes it will be done soon.

Goblin explained that the faster the visas come through, the better it is for the team, because it would give them around seven to eight free days before the event to practise.

PMGC 2026 is being held in Istanbul, Türkiye, with the Grand Finals from December 11 to 13. SouL are India’s only team at the event. They qualified by winning BMSD 2026 and start in the Gauntlet stage, according to KRAFTON India.

Indian teams play BGMI at home, while PMGC is played on PUBG Mobile, so time to settle in and practise in the same conditions as the event helps. KRAFTON India’s Karan Pathak made the same point when he spoke to TalkEsport during BMIC 2026. He suggested Indian teams travel early, either to Nepal or to Türkiye ahead of the event, so they can practise there. You can read his full comments in our interview with Karan Pathak .

Visa delays are a familiar worry for Indian esports teams heading abroad. In 2025, GodLike Esports left Call of Duty: Mobile esports after failing to secure player visas for a world championship. There is nothing to suggest SouL are in that position. Goblin was clear that the visas will happen, and the question is only how soon.

For now, SouL fans will be waiting on the next update. Every team at the event is listed in our guide to the PMGC 2026 qualified teams . We will update this story when SouL confirm their visas and travel plans.

title: Fluxo pause their CS team and point to Valve’s new Major model
content:
The Brazilian organisation keep exit, dav1deuS and coach Juve under contract and release the rest after four years in Counter-Strike.

Fluxo are stepping away from Counter-Strike. The Brazilian organisation said on Tuesday evening that it will “pause and reassess” its CS division, and it put the Major first among the reasons.

🚨 COMUNICADO OFICIAL! pic.twitter.com/vGOXRe3KEq

After the recent changes to the format and remuneration model of CS Majors, combined with the loss of a fundamental strategic partner for the operation, we made the difficult decision to pause and reassess our participation in the game.

The changes Fluxo refer to arrived with IEM Cologne 2026 in June. Sticker capsules are gone. Fans buy stickers in a token shop, and the half of the money that Valve shares is split by VRS seeding before the event and by final placings after it. The whole field is now invited straight from the Valve Regional Standings. Fluxo did not say which part hurt most, or who the lost partner was.

The news was first reported by Dust2 Brasil and HLTV a few hours earlier.

title: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang Returns to Office and Apologises to Executives After Affair Disclosure
content:
Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang returned to the company’s headquarters in Santa Clara, California, on Monday 9 November and led his regular morning meeting with senior executives. He opened the closed-door meeting by addressing his extramarital affair and apologising to staff, CNBC reported , citing people familiar with the meeting. The people said Huang did not take questions. He then moved on to business and the day’s main agenda items.

The people CNBC cited asked not to be named because they were not authorised to speak publicly. Employees described the mood inside the company as “sad”, according to the report. One employee told the broadcaster they were shocked by Huang’s disclosure.

Huang, 63, told Nvidia employees in an email on Sunday 8 November that he had had an extramarital affair. The email does not say with whom he had the relationship. “I was unfaithful to my wife,” he wrote, as reported by Al Jazeera. He also wrote that he hoped “over time” to earn back staff trust, CNBC reported.

The disclosure followed a New York Times report on 29 October. The newspaper reported that a Chinese woman had sought close ties with Huang to gather information about Nvidia’s technology. The Financial Times reported that Huang had been in a romantic relationship with Alice Huang, a former executive at Megaspeed. She is not related to Jensen Huang. Megaspeed became one of Nvidia’s largest buyers, purchasing about $4.8bn in equipment, according to Al Jazeera.

The claim that she sought to gather information for China is unverified. No charges have been reported, and no US authority has published any finding. China’s foreign ministry spokesperson, Guo Jiakun, called the allegation “unsubstantiated” on 9 November. TalkEsport has reported separately on claims linking Alice Huang to a Shanghai chip distributor .

Nvidia’s board said on 8 November that a committee of independent directors would investigate, with outside counsel. The board said it had “no reason to believe” that national security or Nvidia secrets had been compromised. It also expressed confidence in Huang, who continues to lead the company during the review. The board hired the law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz on Tuesday 10 November, CNBC reported. As we covered in our report on Nvidia’s choice of investigators , the firm is leading the probe. Nvidia has not said when the review will end or whether its findings will be published.

title: Destro Talks About BMIC 2026, Claims There’s Not Much of a Skill Gap Except With NSR
content:
It’s been over a week since Battlegrounds Mobile India International Cup 2026 (BMIC 2026) concluded , but the dominance displayed by the South Korean teams, especially Nongshim RedForce (NSR), continues to be a talking point in the Indian esports community. Unlike other regional teams, Indian teams don’t usually get to compete against their international counterparts that often. Hence, understandably, Indian fans are keen to understand more about the competition and where India stands on a global or international scale.

In a recent livestream , a viewer asked Destro about the level of competition Gladiator Esports faced in BMIC 2026. Responding to this, Destro confidently expressed his belief that there is not much of a skill difference between Indian teams and two of the five South Korean teams, Game PT and FOCUS, that participated in BMIC 2026.

“Honestly, I feel like their two teams (Game PT and FOCUS) weren’t particularly different from other teams. I didn’t really feel there was much of a difference between the two teams.”

Speaking about the BMIC 2026 winners, Nongshim RedForce, Destro maintained that the team was way ahead of its competition, in BMIC 2026, as well as in South Korea.

“One team has clearly gone way ahead. Their leagues are also way ahead, in my opinion.”

Turning his attention towards the Japanese contingent at BMIC 2026, Destro offered a less favourable feedback.

title: Poison Ivy wins first CoD Mobile Garena Battle Royale Cup
content:
Poison Ivy were crowned the champions of the inaugural Call of Duty: Mobile – Garena Battle Royale Cup in front of their home crowd in Manila, Philippines. This follows their dominant Playoffs run, with the team looking forward to truly global competitions.

The Call of Duty: Mobile – Garena Battle Royale Cup (CODM – GBRC) is the first major LAN event dedicated to the Battle Royale aspect of CODM. It began with the Qualifier Stage on Sept. 26 and brought the top 10 teams to the offline Grand Finals last Nov. 7-8 .

Teams from the Philippines, Thailand, Taiwan and Hong Kong, and Indonesia made it to the Grand Finals.

For 2027, Garena announced the Rookie Circuit for both Battle Royale and Multiplayer competitors. This is a new, open circuit which runs four times a year and allows players the chance to participate in the highest form of competition: The global World Championship for Multiplayer, and the regional Garena Battle Royale Cup for BR.

The grand finals were played across two days and implemented the new Endgame Protocol. In it, the winning point threshold is set to the points of the leading team after Day 1, plus 10.

Since Poison Ivy ended Map 6, Day 1 at 106 points , the winning threshold was set at 116 points .

title: LEC : G2 a trouvé son nouveau support… et c’est un visage très familier !
content:
Le mercato réserve décidément de nombreuses surprises chez G2 Esports. Alors que la structure allemande prépare une importante reconstruction après son élimination prématurée des Worlds 2026, elle aurait trouvé son nouveau support. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , Mihael « Mikyx » Mehle aurait trouvé un accord verbal avec G2 pour la saison prochaine. Le Slovène de 28 ans, qui évoluait chez SK Gaming cette année, devrait ainsi retrouver une organisation dont il a largement contribué à écrire l’histoire. Un retour qui permettrait notamment de compenser le départ de Lampros « Labrov » Papoutsakis, attendu chez le rival Fnatic malgré plusieurs propositions de prolongation.

Mais l’opération ne serait pas encore totalement bouclée. Toujours selon la même source, l’accord de Mikyx dépendrait notamment de la situation de G2 sur la toplane, un poste encore vacant après le départ annoncé de BrokenBlade vers Movistar KOI. Le support aurait également discuté avec LYON, pensionnaire de LCS, qui resterait une destination possible si les négociations avec G2 venaient à échouer. La structure allemande aurait par ailleurs étudié la piste menant à Parus, actuellement sous contrat avec NAVI, avant de privilégier le retour de son ancien joueur.

Il faut dire que Mikyx connaît parfaitement la maison. Arrivé une première fois en 2019, il avait participé à la période la plus glorieuse de l’histoire de G2, avec notamment un sacre au MSI et une finale des Worlds la même année. Après un passage chez Excel Esports en 2022, il était revenu chez les Samouraïs entre 2023 et 2024, avant de rejoindre Fnatic puis SK Gaming. Avec onze titres de champion d’Europe et un trophée international remportés sous les couleurs de G2, le Slovène possède l’un des plus beaux palmarès de l’histoire du LEC. Une expérience précieuse pour une équipe en quête de stabilité.

Son dernier passage chez SK Gaming aura toutefois été beaucoup moins convaincant. Malgré un effectif ambitieux composé notamment de Wunder, Skeanz, LIDER et Jopa, la formation allemande n’a jamais réussi à trouver son rythme en 2026, terminant notamment à la onzième place du LEC Versus et manquant l’ensemble des playoffs de la saison. Mikyx pourrait désormais retrouver les sommets avec G2, qui prépare également le retour de Mithy au poste d’entraîneur principal. Avec Caps toujours présent sur la midlane et l’arrivée attendue de Lyncas dans la jungle, les Samouraïs disposeraient déjà de trois joueurs pour 2027. Reste à trouver un nouveau toplaner et à clarifier l’avenir de Hans Sama pour compléter cette reconstruction.

title: Best competitive loadout in Modern Warfare 4 – Hardpoint and Search & Destroy
content:
A new Call of Duty means the competitive scene is completely wiped clean, and players can start totally fresh. Modern Warfare 4 introduces an entirely new set of rules, maps, weapons, and restrictions that players must follow if they want to play competitively. While some of what you use in public matches can carry over into competitive, you’ll need a specific loadout if you want to succeed at the highest level in Modern Warfare 4.

Fortunately, we have assembled the best pro-ready loadout for competitive play in MW4, and it comes with the weapons, attachments, perks, and equipment you’ll need on each of your classes. You can see everything you need for your competitive loadouts for both primary game modes, Hardpoint and Search & Destroy, in the guide below.

We’ll begin with your loadout for Hardpoint in Modern Warfare 4, as it’s the main respawn game mode that you’ll play in competitive. While there’s also Hijack, the new third game mode in the Call of Duty League, the loadout for Hardpoint will transfer over to that mode as well.

The two current weapons that have ascended to the meta in competitive play are the HAN 86 assault rifle and the VEL-46 submachine gun. While updates and GAs could change the weapon meta, this is what has stuck in the early going of MW4. Pros have also defaulted to using the Sang 9mm pistol as the lone secondary weapon option, and that likely won’t change anytime soon.

Below, you can see the best attachments for both the HAN 86 and the VEL-46, as well as the rest of the recommended loadout for Hardpoint:

For the perks, the Perk 1 slot is currently unbalanced for competitive play, as there are no true viable options. Hopefully, developer Infinity Ward issues a fix in the near future and rebalances the perks, but for right now, your only option is Kill Chain, which does virtually nothing in Hardpoint. As for the rest of the loadout, everything else is pretty much set in stone except for your choice of lethal equipment.
