After lawyering up Epic claims they fully own the rights to Jazz Jackrabbit and won't back down in spite of not having any paperwork to prove it (nor do I) in spite of the fact that they still pay me from sales of it on GoG (which means paperwork exists somewhere) and are still… pic.twitter.com/tD5UKfKtye

In his conversation with IGN , Bleszinski revealed that EPIC Games continues to pay him a royalty for the Jazz Jackrabbit sales on GOG, which hints that the original contractual documentation could still exist somewhere. Given that he created the paperwork years ago, he lacks the necessary ammunition to take on EPIC Games through legal channels.

Accepting the difficulties surrounding the situation, Bleszinski has considered a “spiritual successor” to Jazz Jackrabbit as he rules out conventional methods to revive the series. Reviving the essence of the series under a different umbrella is understood by him as the best way forward. The “spiritual successor” will likely carry over the elements of the original character that avoid invoking a legal battle with EPIC.

title: ARC Raiders Sales Hit 17 Million as Nexon Expects Flat Revenue
content:
ARC Raiders sales have passed 17 million copies, according to Nexon’s Q3 2026 earnings report. The number comes with a caveat. Nexon said the game’s Q3 revenue matched its outlook, and it expects Q4 revenue from the game to stay about the same. Sales have slowed noticeably since the extraction shooter launched on October 30, 2025.

This article covers the new sales total, the full sales timeline, the revenue outlook, Nexon’s wider results, and the player count changes tied to recent updates.

Nexon confirmed the 17 million figure in its Q3 2026 earnings report . Embark Studios, the developer, is a Nexon subsidiary.

The report says ARC Raiders revenue for Q3 came in line with Nexon’s forecast. For Q4, Nexon expects the game’s revenue to stay broadly flat compared to the previous quarter. In short, the game still sells, but revenue is no longer growing.

The total looks smaller next to earlier jumps. ARC Raiders reached 16 million copies in May 2026. That means it added about 1 million copies in roughly six months.

The game started fast. It sold more than 4 million copies in its first 12 days on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S. The table below shows how the total has grown since then.

title: Claude Fable 5.2 Is Making Whole Games From a Single Prompt, What Does That Mean for Game Development?
content:
Within a day of its launch, Claude Fable 5.2 had turned X into a showroom for games that nobody coded by hand. Anthropic released the model at 18:58 UTC on 9 November, and its announcement post passed 12.6 million views by Tuesday. Users quickly began posting shooters, racing games, a boat ride through dreamlike worlds and a medieval MMO village, all built by the model. The most shared demo came from Felix Rieseberg, who works at Anthropic, and whose first-person shooter had close to a million views.

I wanted to test Fable 5.2's quality with one-shot prompts without human feedback. Everything in this game is from scratch: models, sounds, textures. ~$550 at API pricing, ~2.7M output and 445M input tokens, heavily cached. Took 8 hours! Play it here: https://t.co/fazOCcyNIH pic.twitter.com/GoCitQ9EVe

Rieseberg said he wanted to test the model “with one-shot prompts without human feedback”. According to his post, everything in the game, from the 3D models to the sounds and textures, was made from scratch over eight hours. He put the cost at about $550 at API prices, using around 2.7 million output tokens and 445 million input tokens, most of them cached. The game is playable in a browser , and footage from it shows an objective to cut three uplink relays inside a warehouse.

Fable 5.2 is the third model in Anthropic’s Fable line since June, and the company describes it as its most capable model for technical work. Its official page lists building “interactive 3D worlds” among its strengths, alongside coding, research and robotics. It also quotes a creative technologist at Unity, who says the model is “very strong on the harder game-dev tasks”. Anthropic cut the API price to $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens, down from $10 and $50 for Fable 5.1, and the benchmark scores on its page are the company’s own.

The demos cover most of the genres that fill a storefront. Creative coder Kevin Ngo posted a boat ride through eight dreamlike worlds , playable in the browser, which passed 320,000 views. Another user, Izkimar, said he built an entire MMO world in a single day, and that “every single asset you see was generated from code”. He argued that stylised art was a bigger test for the model than hyperrealism, and his footage shows a village of stone cottages, dirt paths and autumn trees.

The most ambitious claim came from the user ericmaskfr, who posted a Grand Theft Auto style city just over a week before GTA 6 launches. He said it took a single prompt, 2 hours and 14 minutes and a $200 subscription plan. His list of features includes a five-star wanted system, carjacking, a garage with paint jobs and neon underglow, nine districts and a day-to-night cycle. He also claimed that an indie studio would quote $90,000 and eight months for a similar prototype, a figure he did not source.

title: Nintendo eShop Gifting: Release Date, How It Works, Limits
content:
Nintendo eShop gifting is coming to Switch and Switch 2 in November 2026. Nintendo released system update 23.5.0 on November 9 to prepare both consoles for the feature. Players will be able to buy eligible games, DLC, and upgrade packs for members of their Nintendo Account family group. Nintendo’s US announcement lists November 16 as the launch date, while the patch notes list November 17.

This article explains the release date, how gifting works, the limits, and the other changes in the update.

Nintendo announced the feature on November 9, 2026. It will arrive through a Nintendo eShop update, not through the system update itself. The system update only adds the support the consoles need.

The patch notes say the gifting feature will be available after an eShop update scheduled for November 17, 2026. Nintendo’s US announcement says the feature arrives on November 16. Nintendo has not explained the one-day difference.

Gifting will work on both Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2. Both consoles need system software version 23.5.0 or later.

Players can gift eligible games, DLC, and upgrade packs. Gifts are only possible between members of the same Nintendo Account family group. A family group can have up to 8 members.

title: Cloud9 Enters Competitive Deadlock by Signing Melee Creeps Roster
content:
Cloud9 has officially announced its entry into the competitive Deadlock space after signing the Melee Creeps roster.

For the unaware, Deadlock is Valve’s hero shooter MOBA hybrid that has been making waves in the gaming realm over the past few months due to its unique gameplay mechanics and eye-catching updates . Even though the game is unreleased and still in an invite-only closed beta phase, it has already managed to cultivate a thriving competitive scene, with several teams and organizations beginning to make their mark in the emerging esports ecosystem.

Cloud9’s announcement comes from its official X handle , and it sees the org picking up the currently undefeated Melee Creeps Deadlock roster. The team has won six consecutive Night Shift events and has yet to concede a match in competitive play since its current lineup came together.

Greetings from the Cursed Apple The Melee Creeps are on Cloud9. pic.twitter.com/1spRSJzMcf

Cloud9 first entered the esports scene in 2012 with a League of Legends roster and has since grown into one of North America’s most prominent esports organizations. Over the years, the org has fielded teams across several titles, including Dota 2, Hearthstone, and Counter-Strike: Global Offensive, among many others. Cloud9 also made history in CSGO as the first and only organization to win a Major with a North American lineup.

Cloud9’s entry into Deadlock marks the org’s return to a Valve title after a lengthy absence. Having disbanded its CS2 roster in January 2025, the organization had gone 22 months without fielding a team in a Valve game before bringing Melee Creeps on board.

title: LFL : Solary dit adieu à Kryze, une légende du club
content:
C’est une page importante de l’histoire de Solary qui se tourne. La structure française a officialisé le départ de Felix « Kryze » Hellström, son toplaner depuis le début de l’année 2024. À 27 ans, le Suédois quitte le club après trois saisons durant lesquelles il aura largement contribué à sa progression sur la scène compétitive de League of Legends. Arrivé dans une équipe encore en quête de résultats, il s’en va aujourd’hui avec un palmarès bien garni et une place particulière dans le cœur des supporters.

Dans son message d’adieu, Solary n’a pas caché son émotion, rendant un hommage appuyé à l’un des visages emblématiques de son projet. « Felix aura fait partie de l’aventure pendant 3 ans et pendant tout ce temps, il aura été le joueur rêvé, le coéquipier rêvé et tout ce dont on peut espérer d’un joueur et d’une personne. » La structure tourangelle a également salué son parcours avec des mots particulièrement forts : « Tu es arrivé avec tout à construire et tu repars aujourd’hui comme une légende du club. » Un hommage à la hauteur de son investissement et de son importance dans les succès récents de l’équipe.

Kryze quitte Solary au terme d’un exercice 2026 particulièrement réussi. Avec ses coéquipiers, le Suédois a remporté deux titres de champion de France en LFL, ainsi que les EMEA Masters Winter. La formation tourangelle a ensuite atteint la finale des EMEA Masters Spring, avant de décrocher une nouvelle médaille d’argent lors du World Star Challengers Invitational, après une défaite face à T1 Academy (2-3). Solary a finalement conclu sa saison sur une troisième finale internationale perdue, cette fois aux EMEA Masters Summer contre Galions (2-3). Une régularité impressionnante qui a permis à la structure de s’imposer parmi les références des ligues régionales européennes.

Malgré ces dernières désillusions, Kryze laisse derrière lui un héritage considérable, après avoir accompagné Solary dans l’une des plus belles périodes de son histoire. Son départ s’inscrit également dans une importante reconstruction de l’effectif pour 2027, avec les arrivées attendues de plusieurs nouveaux talents. Reste désormais à savoir où le vétéran suédois poursuivra sa carrière, lui qui avait notamment été évoqué parmi les candidats à une place en LEC.

Felix aura fait partie de l'aventure pendant 3 ans et pendant tout ce temps, il aura été le joueur rêvé, le coéquipier rêvé et tout ce dont on peut espérer d'un joueur et d'une personne. Merci pour tout @KryzeLoL tu es arrivé avec tout à construire et tu repars aujourd'hui comme… pic.twitter.com/mK0vfdUHAq

title: Virtus.pro make stand-in Patsi permanent with F0R3VER inactive
content:
The former Spirit and Liquid player earns the spot after winning a title as a stand-in, while F0R3VER moves to the inactive roster for health reasons.

Virtus.pro have signed Robert “Patsi” Isyanov on a permanent basis, the club announced on Tuesday 10 November. The 23-year-old Russian takes the place of Dias “F0R3VER” Kutubay, who moves to the inactive roster due to health reasons, as HLTV also reported.

In its statement , the club said that “Robert has already been playing for the team as a stand-in, and his cooperation with Virtus.pro will now continue on a permanent basis.” It gave no further detail on F0R3VER’s condition.

We wish Dias a speedy recovery and hope to see him return to competitive play in the future.

CS2 roster update. We're excited to announce that @PatsiCS2 officially joins our roster after representing Virtus.рro as a stand-in! He replaces F0R3VER, who moves to the inactive roster due to health reasons. We wish Dias a speedy recovery and hope to see him back in action… pic.twitter.com/blbpBHUn5h

F0R3VER has not played for VP since early October. On 9 October the club pulled out of the Thunderpick World Championship in Malta, an event it had qualified for, after F0R3VER stepped away for health reasons and AquaRS ran into visa problems. Ninjas in Pyjamas took the place instead .

title: Jimpphat Denies Ex-Girlfriend’s Racism and Love-Bombing Claims in 16-Slide Douyin Statement
content:
Aurora rifler Jimi “Jimpphat” Salo has denied the allegations made against him by a woman who says she is his former girlfriend. In a 16-slide post on a Douyin account in his name , published in the early hours of 9 November, Beijing time, he rejected her accusations of racism, love-bombing and what he called “so called ‘yellow fever'”.

The statement, written in English, says the two dated from December 2024 to July 2025, in what he describes as his first relationship. He also accused her of “posting a lot of lies about me in social media” since they stopped having contact.

jimpphat responded with his side of story on Douyin. Summary of Jimi's points: – It was his first relationship. He was 18 and she was 20. Their relationship lasted from 2024 Dec to 2025 Jul. – He never tried to love bomb or manipulate her. – After breaking up, she posted a lot… https://t.co/h5K85yPZPp pic.twitter.com/fBJZztEcUh

The response came two days after the woman’s own statement, also posted on Douyin, began circulating on X, as we reported in our original story on the allegations . Most English-speaking fans saw his reply through X, where the fan account Uchiha Flora shared his slides with a summary at 11:36 UTC on 9 November. That post had passed 80,000 views by Tuesday. TalkEsport has viewed the Douyin post, which had drawn close to 1,000 likes and 134 comments, but has not verified the claims made by either side.

Jimpphat began by explaining why he had decided to speak at all. He wrote that he “really didn’t want to make a response at all”, but that many people were now talking about the claims and might see his silence as a sign of guilt. He then turned to the most serious allegation, writing that she “didn’t show any proof again because it’s not true at all”. He said he has “a lot of friends from all over Asia”, enjoys playing there and goes on holiday in the region, and he called the claim a “totally false accusation”.

He also rejected the claim that he love-bombed her around the Perfect World Shanghai Major in 2024. “I’ve never love bombed or in any way tried to manipulate her to stay with me,” he wrote, pointing out that he had just turned 18 and was two years younger than her. He called it “ironical” that she described herself as “young” and “naive”, since he says he had no relationship experience before her. On the “yellow fever” claim, he said he had laughed at it because it was “absurd”, and that he had simply preferred long-distance relationships in the past.

title: PGL Moves Its $1 Million April 2027 CS2 Event From China to Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia
content:
PGL will take a $1 million Counter-Strike 2 event to Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia, from 14 to 26 April 2027, moving a tournament it had originally announced for China. The Romanian organiser confirmed PGL Ulaanbaatar 2027 on X at 09:32 UTC on 10 November, which was 5:32pm in the Mongolian capital. Sixteen teams will play the event entirely on LAN, with a separate $300,000 VRS Invite Bonus for the highest-ranked teams that accept their invites. PGL’s official announcement says the visa region “has been updated from China to Mongolia, in coordination with Valve”, and that all other details remain unchanged.

Ulaanbaatar, we're coming! 14-26 April 2027 Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia 16 elite CS2 teams $1,000,000 on the line $300,000 VRS Invite Bonus for the top-ranked teams Everything you need to know: https://t.co/VUxDURKFq7 #PGLUlaanbaatar pic.twitter.com/Nc2J4TqtEv

The dates, prize money and bonus all match what PGL announced on 15 June, when it first revealed the April 2027 event under a China banner. PGL has not said why the tournament moved, or whether a Chinese host city had been chosen before the change. It has not yet named a venue in Ulaanbaatar either. Purevdagva, the city’s governor and mayor, said in PGL’s release that hosting the event was “an important milestone in our ambition to put Mongolia on the global esports map”.

Fourteen of the 16 places will go to direct invites, which PGL will send on 4 January 2027 based on the Valve Regional Standings published that day. The other two spots come from online qualifiers, one for Europe and one for Asia, with open qualifiers from 27 to 30 January and closed qualifiers from 1 to 4 February. Asia’s path is split into Oceania, West and East sub-regions, whose three winners meet in an online Asia Final for the last place. Seeding for the main event will follow the VRS ranking published on 5 April 2027.

The $1 million is split between team prize money and a club share paid to the organisations. The champions will take $280,000 in total, made up of $180,000 in prize money and a $100,000 club share, while the runners-up receive $155,000. Every team that finishes between fifth and eighth earns $64,000, and the bottom two finishers leave with $2,500 each. Teams that commit and then pull out also face PGL’s new rulebook, under which withdrawing can cost $30,000 .

The bonus pool works separately from the prize money. Each of the top five VRS teams that accepts an invite will receive $60,000, and if a team declines, the offer passes down the ranking as far as the 14th-placed team. If less than $200,000 of the pool is paid out, PGL will move the remainder into its Annual Viewership Incentive. That fund is worth $2.8 million across PGL’s Tier 1 CS2 events in 2027, and it pays the 16 teams that draw the highest average concurrent viewership.

title: “GTA 7 Won’t Be Another 13-Year Wait”, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick Signals
content:
Take-Two Interactive chief executive Strauss Zelnick has signalled that players will not wait another 13 years for the Grand Theft Auto game that follows GTA 6. Speaking to IGN after Take-Two’s second-quarter results on 9 November, he was asked whether the next GTA would take as long as GTA 6 did. He replied that “the nature and velocity of the content we’ll see from our iconic franchises, including GTA” would “look dramatically different over the next decade”. Zelnick did not use the name GTA 7, and he gave no release window for any future Rockstar game.

The comments spread quickly after Insider Gaming’s Tom Henderson shared them on X at 00:26 UTC on 10 November, under the headline “GTA 7 Won’t Take as Long as GTA 6, Says Take-Two CEO”. His post passed 228,000 views within ten hours. According to reports of the interview, Zelnick linked the change to three aims: releasing high-quality entertainment, reaching players in new ways and places, and keeping them engaged after launch. Rockstar Games itself has not announced its next project.

The interview came on the day Take-Two reported results for the three months to 30 September. According to the company’s earnings release , GAAP net revenue fell to $1.50 billion from $1.77 billion a year earlier, while Net Bookings dropped 18% to $1.60 billion. Take-Two kept its full-year forecast of $8.0 billion to $8.2 billion in Net Bookings, which covers the GTA 6 launch because its financial year runs until the end of March 2027. Recurrent consumer spending, which includes GTA Online, made up 81% of Net Bookings in the quarter, and the results call was webcast through Take-Two’s investor relations site at 4:30pm in New York.

Zelnick’s statement in the release looked at the next ten days rather than the next decade. “The launch of Grand Theft Auto VI is ten days away,” he said, adding that pre-orders were “continuing to reach unprecedented levels”. Take-Two did not publish a pre-order figure, although estimates have circulated for weeks, as our round-up of GTA 6 pre-order estimates shows. Grand Theft Auto VI launches on 19 November on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and Rockstar opened digital pre-loading on 10 November.

Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival, a special live event on November 21 at Mana Wynwood in Miami to celebrate the launch of GTAVI, featuring a star-studded lineup of artists from the game and the official soundtrack. More info: https://t.co/XRlfYFOk0H pic.twitter.com/fQyOU7I4gU

The gap Zelnick was asked about is the longest in the history of the series. GTA 5 launched in September 2013, and Rockstar did not confirm that a new Grand Theft Auto was in development until February 2022. GTA 6 was first due in autumn 2025, before Rockstar delayed it to 26 May 2026 and then, in November 2025, to 19 November 2026. Our GTA 6 timeline sets out every step, while GTA Online, which launched in October 2013, kept the older game earning money throughout.

title: Cricket 07 Now Runs in Unreal Engine 5, and the Fan Behind Its Browser Port Wants Playtesters
content:
Developer Dhaiwat says he has ported EA Sports Cricket 07, the 2006 PC game, into Unreal Engine 5, keeping its original gameplay while giving it modern graphics. He shared two clips on X at 02:08 UTC on 10 November, writing that he had “somehow managed to port over a 2006 cricket game into unreal engine 5”. He also asked fans to reply if they wanted to help him playtest it, with a warning to “expect a lot of bugs”. By Tuesday morning, the post had passed 30,000 views and drawn more than 100 replies.

i have somehow managed to port over a 2006 cricket game into unreal engine 5 :)) exact same old gameplay with 2026 graphics. crazy how this project was a bare skeleton less than a week ago pls drop a reply below if you want to help me playtest. expect a lot of bugs https://t.co/ISP7rNJIuu pic.twitter.com/cYCqm6rGl8

The Unreal Engine project has moved remarkably quickly. Dhaiwat said it had been “a bare skeleton less than a week ago”. His first update came at 22:45 UTC on 3 November, when he wrote that he had “just played one ball” of the game in the engine. The new clips show a two-over exhibition between India and England at Lord’s. One frame shows England’s Steve Harmison bowling to an Indian batter with an invented name, a quirk of a game that licensed only four national teams.

Dhaiwat has been open about what still holds the visuals back. In a reply to one fan , he said the limit “is still assets”, meaning the player models and kits, and that it “will look 100x better once those are remastered”. He also told another user that this version is “a desktop game for mac and windows”, unlike his earlier browser port. He has not said how playtesters will get access, or whether the Unreal Engine build will be released publicly.

The Unreal Engine project grew out of a browser port that spread widely in October. On 20 October, Dhaiwat shared a version of Cricket 07 with “an online multiplayer mode” that needed nothing more than a web browser. That post has since passed 2.1 million views and 14,000 likes. On 29 October, he said more than 50,000 recent online matches had been played on it.

He explained the method when he released the code on 22 October. Rather than running the game in an emulator, he took the original 2006 Windows executable and statically recompiled it into C, then wrote a small layer to stand in for the Windows functions the game expects. The game’s Direct3D 8 graphics calls were translated to WebGPU, and the whole program was compiled to WebAssembly with Emscripten. Online matches run on netplay over WebSockets, with one Cloudflare Durable Object handling each room.

title: What It Really Costs to Play GTA 6 in India
content:
Getting into GTA 6 in India will cost most players somewhere between ₹55,000 and ₹71,000 on launch day. The most reliable figure is ₹70,989, the price Amazon India listed for a PS5 Slim Digital bundled with the Standard Edition in late October. An Xbox Series S could be cheaper on paper, at around ₹54,500 with the game, but only if you can find one near Microsoft’s list price.

Compare that with BGMI, which millions of Indians play every day for free on a phone they already own. Rockstar’s biggest game in more than a decade arrives on November 19, and for a lot of Indian players, the real question is not when it releases but whether they can afford to get in.

The game itself costs the same on both platforms. The Standard Edition is ₹5,999 and the Ultimate Edition is ₹7,499 on both the PlayStation Store India and the Xbox Store India . Standard owners can upgrade later for ₹1,500. The console is where the money goes.

PS5 Slim prices and bundles are Amazon India listings from October 28, as reported by Business Today. The PS5 Pro price is from Bajaj Finserv’s EMI listing, updated on October 17, which showed it out of stock. *Xbox prices are estimates. Microsoft raised Xbox prices worldwide from August 1, and the figures above are the estimated new Indian prices reported by The Sunday Guardian, not official Microsoft India pricing. Before that rise, the Series S started at ₹39,990 and the Series X at ₹59,990.

Do not be surprised to see much higher Xbox prices online. Many listings come from third-party sellers. In July, Smartprix tracked a Series S 1TB on Flipkart at ₹73,999, and this month a Series X on Flipkart was listed by a third-party seller at ₹1,07,220. Check who the seller is before you pay.

One more detail matters for PS5 buyers. GTA 6’s retail box contains a download code, not a disc, so the extra ₹4,995 for the PS5 with a disc drive buys you nothing for GTA 6 at launch.

title: All five MOUZ players collect HLTV awards from Beijing
content:
torzsi, Spinx, xelex and PR join MVP xertioN among the honours, and MOUZ fill the maximum three places in the IEM Beijing All-Star team.

Four of HLTV’s seven EVPs from IEM Beijing 2026 play for MOUZ . No MOUZ player leaves Beijing unappreciated as they claim four of the seven latest HLTV EVPs ⭐️ @w0nderfulof @torzsics @SpinxCS2 @b1tcs @Techno4K @PRcsgoo @xelexcs pic.twitter.com/rL5zc2xK0k

title: ScoutOP Reportedly Gets Four Bigg Boss 20 Punishments After Pushing Yung DSA, Including Eviction at Any Time
content:
Tanmay Singh, the esports star known as Scout, has reportedly been handed four punishments on Bigg Boss 20 after pushing rapper Yung DSA during a captaincy task. According to fan accounts that follow the show’s 24-hour channel on JioHotstar , Scout will stay nominated for the rest of the season and can no longer become captain. He also loses access to any special powers, and Bigg Boss can evict him at any time.

Neither JioHotstar nor Colors TV had released a promo of the decision by Tuesday, and the episode covering the fight had not yet aired.

BREAKING: SCOUT OP FACES 4 MAJOR PUNISHMENTS AFTER PHYSICAL FIGHT WITH YUNG DSA! Bigg Boss takes STRICT action against Scout following the physical fight with Yung DSA! Here are the 4 major punishments announced: • Nominated for the ENTIRE SEASON! • No more Captaincy…

The first reports of the fight appeared on X at around 14:30 UTC on Monday, 9 November, which was 8pm in Mumbai, where the show is filmed. The list of punishments followed at about 19:15 UTC, a quarter to one in the morning on 10 November in Mumbai. A post by the fan news account Bigg Boss Tak setting out the four penalties had passed 400,000 views by Tuesday morning. By then, #YungDSA was among the topics trending in India on X.

The clash came in the second round of a captaincy task, in which Uditi Singh sat on a robot chair while Scout’s side tried to make her cry. According to the live-feed reports, Scout singed the edge of one of her family photographs as part of that effort. Gullu, whose real name is Kushal Tanwar, and Yung DSA kept interrupting and commenting on what he was doing, and the argument turned into an exchange of abuse. Scout then pushed Yung, who reportedly replied “Ab dosti khatam”, Hindi for “the friendship is over”.

Bigg Boss stepped in straight away, according to the same reports, sending Scout to the bedroom and Yung to the garden and putting the captaincy task on hold . Scout reportedly admitted to the push and apologised, and Yung appeared to accept the apology later on the live feed. Aamrapali Dubey then questioned his decision and urged him to take a firmer stand against physical violence. Yung is reported to have told Bigg Boss that either Scout should leave the house or he would walk out himself.

title: FaZe Clan’s 11.11.26 Teaser Is a $100,000 Call of Duty Tournament: What We Know About FaZe’s Return
content:
FaZe Clan’s cryptic “11.11.26” post now has its first answer: a $100,000 Call of Duty tournament. A few hours after the date appeared on FaZe’s X account on 9 November, the organisation released a trailer for the Flank Invitational, a two-day event on 11 and 12 November. It will be streamed on FaZe’s Twitch channel and on the channel of former Call of Duty pro ZooMaa. The teaser, FaZe’s first original post since March, had passed 600,000 views by Tuesday, and the account’s bio now reads only “11.11.26”.

ZooMaa’s tournament brand, The Flank, confirmed the details in a post on X headed “FAZE X THE FLANK”. It listed a “12 team fantasy draft” on 10 November, followed by the tournament itself on 11 and 12 November. ZooMaa, who still goes by FaZe ZooMaa on X, thanked “the team at @FaZeClan for getting this done” and said the teams would be drafted on Tuesday. FaZe has not said whether the tournament is the whole announcement, or the start of something bigger.

FaZe’s 41-second trailer opens with the words “FaZe Clan presents” over Call of Duty gameplay, and closes on a card reading “$100K Flank Invitational, November 11-12”. In between, it promises a double-elimination bracket across three modes: Hardpoint, Search and Destroy and Hijack. The maps shown carry the Korean street signs of Modern Warfare 4, the current Call of Duty, whose launch patch notes landed in October. No team list, player list or prize split had been published by Tuesday morning, India time.

The fantasy draft format has a history at The Flank. The Flank has run invitationals for Call of Duty League players since 2024, when ZooMaa announced a $100,000 series of Black Ops 6 events for pros. Its last edition, a $20,000 tournament in November 2025, was won by a four-player squad that included CDL player Dashy. In October, ZooMaa said in a clip shared by the account SpawnUp that this year’s event was “not even full teams bc they wouldn’t let me do it, again”, without naming who had blocked full rosters.

The teaser lands almost a year after FaZe’s creator side fell apart. In the last week of 2025, Adapt, JasonTheWeen, Lacy, Silky and Stable Ronaldo announced they were leaving, and FaZe veterans including Apex, Swagg and Rug followed. Bloomberg reported that Matt Kalish, the DraftKings co-founder who invested in FaZe Media in 2024, had asked creators to sign with his new agency, HardScope, or go independent, calling the old model “unsustainable”. On 28 December, FaZe said it was “heartbreaking to see this era of FaZe come to a close”, and that esports would become “our main focus moving forward”.

The main account has been close to silent since then, apart from a $10,000 Modern Warfare 2 trickshot challenge in March. Several of the departed creators moved on together, with Adapt, Silky, JasonTheWeen, Lacy, Marlon and Stable Ronaldo launching a new group, CORE, on 30 April. Co-founder Richard “Banks” Bengtson, who rebooted FaZe in 2024 before stepping down as chief executive in July 2025, replied to the teaser within an hour. “Although I have no part in whatever’s next for this brand, I will always root for its success,” he wrote , adding: “Thank you for changing my life.”

title: Call of Duty Chat Over FaceTime Sparks Bomb Scare and Evacuation at California’s Ontario Airport
content:
A Frontier Airlines plane and part of a terminal at California’s Ontario International Airport were evacuated on Sunday night, after a passenger mistook a man’s Call of Duty chat for a bomb threat. The man had been talking to a friend over FaceTime while the friend played the game, and another passenger heard him mention a bomb. A sweep of the aircraft found no explosive device, and police concluded that no crime had been committed, according to reports. The scare has since become one of the most shared gaming stories on X, where it reached the platform’s Today’s News section.

The incident took place at around 10pm local time on Sunday, 8 November, as the Frontier flight was preparing to depart. According to CBS Los Angeles , a passenger waiting on board heard someone say the words “bomb” and “explosion” and reported it to the crew. The California Post , which spoke to the Ontario Police Department, reported that the passenger heard the man say that “he had a bomb in his backpack”. Neither outlet reported the flight number or where the plane was heading.

Officers detained the man for questioning and confirmed that he was carrying a backpack, police spokesperson Denyse Quezada told the California Post. Passengers were taken off the plane, and the east side of Terminal 2 was cleared while flights were held. A bomb-sniffing dog team searched the aircraft and the surrounding area and found nothing dangerous, according to the same report. The Ontario Fire Department and a bomb squad also responded within minutes.

The man told investigators he had been on FaceTime with a friend who was playing the game online. “The friend was playing a video game called ‘Call of Duty,'” Quezada said, adding that “the subject’s statement was related to a video game and not an actual explosive”. Investigators contacted the friend, who backed up his account, and the man was released. Airport spokesperson Steve Lambert later said the investigation was complete and that operations at Ontario International Airport were resuming.

Reports differ on what happened to the man after he was cleared. CBS Los Angeles reported that all passengers, “including the detained individual”, got back on the plane for departure. The California Post said that everyone except the man was allowed to reboard. The Ontario Police Department had not posted about the incident on its official X account at the time of writing.

For Call of Duty players, talk of bombs and explosions is ordinary match commentary. Search and Destroy, one of the series’ best-known modes, is built entirely around planting or defusing a bomb, and explosives such as C4 and grenades are standard equipment. The mode is a fixture of competitive Call of Duty, and it returns in this year’s Modern Warfare 4, which drew mixed reactions at launch . Out of context, a single excited line from a match can sound alarming to anyone sitting nearby.

title: BIG débarque en RLCS
content:
Le mercato continue de s’agiter sur Rocket League, et cette fois, c’est un nouveau géant de l’esport allemand qui pourrait entrer dans la danse. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , BIG serait sur le point de recruter Damian « Tox » Schäfer, Matheo « osaft » Hapke et Nico « Nico » Majgren, trois joueurs libres ayant annoncé leur association le 23 octobre dernier. Une arrivée historique pour l’organisation berlinoise, fondée en 2017 et particulièrement connue pour ses équipes sur Counter-Strike et League of Legends. BIG a également connu le succès sur Fortnite, avec notamment un sacre à l’Esports World Cup, et souhaiterait désormais étendre ses activités à Rocket League.

Pour ses premiers pas sur la scène compétitive, BIG miserait sur un mélange d’expérience et de jeunesse. Présent en RLCS depuis 2020, Tox apporterait son vécu au groupe, après avoir notamment terminé deuxième des qualifications européennes de la dernière chance pour les Worlds 2026 avec Volare. À ses côtés, le Danois Nico, âgé de 17 ans, sort d’une saison encourageante chez NOVO Esports, tandis que son homologue allemand osaft, également âgé de 17 ans, s’est illustré sur la scène du 1v1. Demi-finaliste de l’European 1v1 Open en 2026, ce dernier avait notamment remporté le championnat d’Europe FIFAe avec Tox sous les couleurs de l’Allemagne. Le trio serait accompagné de l’entraîneur norvégien Kasper « Kasper » Sjølstad, ancien membre de WYLDE.

Cette nouvelle formation devrait rapidement avoir l’occasion de se mesurer aux meilleures équipes européennes. Le trio figure parmi les candidats les plus sérieux aux qualifications ouvertes du London Club Kick-Off, aux côtés notamment de Geekay Esports et d’Ikkaku, la nouvelle équipe formée par Rezears, yujin et le Français ExoTiiK. Un premier rendez-vous important pour BIG, qui ne fait pas partie des 20 organisations invitées à intégrer le programme de partenariat des RLCS 2027.

L’organisation allemande aurait d’ailleurs dû faire face à une concurrence importante pour s’attacher les services du trio. Toujours selon la même source, l’Eintracht Francfort, également présent sur League of Legends, aurait tenté sa chance, tout comme Five Fears et NOVO Esports. BIG semble finalement avoir pris l’avantage dans ce dossier, même si aucune signature n’a encore été officialisée. Avec un vétéran expérimenté et deux jeunes talents prometteurs, la structure berlinoise pourrait rapidement se faire une place parmi les outsiders de la scène européenne.

title: After Activision apologizes, moves to trim real Itaewon crush footage from Modern Warfare 4, Korea’s game regulator is unimpressed
content:
Activision will remove real footage of the 2022 Itaewon crowd crush from Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 in an update on 12 November. The decision follows protests from the families of the 159 people who died, who condemned the clip’s use in the game’s opening cinematic. The publisher apologised on 30 October, a week after launch, saying it had never meant to evoke or make light of any real tragedy. South Korea’s game regulator has made it clear, however, that taking the clip out will not settle the matter, and it is now looking at how the footage got past the country’s age-rating process.

The clip lasts about three seconds and appears in a montage of news reports about a fictional North Korean invasion of the South, which is how the campaign opens. Players identified it as real broadcast footage of people performing CPR on a victim in Itaewon on 29 October 2022. That night, a Halloween crowd crush in a narrow alley became one of the worst peacetime disasters in South Korea’s recent history. Modern Warfare 4 had launched worldwide on 23 October, only six days before the fourth anniversary, and its Korean War setting had already dragged the game into South Korean politics .

The 10·29 Itaewon Disaster Bereaved Families Association and a coalition of civic groups issued a joint statement on 28 October. They said they could not help but be appalled that scenes of citizens performing CPR had been “used unchanged to create a scene in a game”. They added that many people who helped with the rescue, or simply witnessed the disaster, are still living with trauma, and called the use of the tragedy as entertainment highly inappropriate. The families also pointed to hateful comments online that mocked the disaster by linking the crush to the game’s war setting.

The Korea Game Users Association, which speaks for players rather than the industry, backed the demand on the same day. It said real disaster footage “unrelated to the game’s progression” had revived the families’ pain, and asked Activision to explain why the clip was needed, apologise to those affected and replace it. Activision’s first response, given to Yonhap News Agency, was far more guarded. It said a few real news scenes had been used to convey the game’s fictional story, and that it had no intention of referencing or trivialising the Itaewon disaster. It did not, however, say whether the footage would be removed.

The tone changed completely when Activision spoke again two days later, in a statement sent to Korean media on 30 October. It described Modern Warfare 4 as “a work of fiction created to provide realistic immersion” and apologised to the bereaved families and victims. It also said the footage “will be completely removed” in the 12 November update. Infinity Ward’s Season 1 patch notes , published on 5 November, contain only one line for the campaign, on performance fixes. They make no mention of the cinematic, which leaves next week’s update as the date to watch.

The row has also reached the government, which is where the bigger questions for Activision now sit. Yun Ho-jung, the head of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety , told a press briefing on 29 October that including the footage amounted to “secondary harm” and that “appropriate sanctions should be imposed”. He added that any decision to punish the game or block access to it belonged to the relevant agencies. That phrase carries real weight in South Korea, where the Cabinet passed a revision to the Itaewon special act in February to give legal grounds for punishing the secondary victimisation of those affected by the crush.

title: Modern Warfare 4 Season 1 Weapon Buffs and Nerfs: Every Gun That Changed
content:
Modern Warfare 4 Season 1 brings 18 weapon balance changes to multiplayer, and almost all of them are buffs. Only the APOC-338 LMG takes a straight nerf, while the HYEON BURST and VEL 46 get a mix of ups and downs. The rest gain damage, range or both.

The pattern is clear once you read the numbers. Infinity Ward is pulling weaker guns up rather than knocking the strongest ones down, so expect your loadout options to widen rather than shrink this season.

Six assault rifles change in Season 1, more than any other class. Most of the gains are in range and headshot damage, which rewards players who can hold their aim at mid distance.

The AXION change is the one to try first. A jump from 415 to 470 m/s muzzle velocity means bullets reach long-range targets noticeably faster, and it comes with almost four extra metres of medium-damage range.

The WZ.55 STRIGA comes out of this as the big winner among SMGs. A head multiplier of 1.4 is the highest on this list, and the two-point bump to minimum damage helps it in fights it used to lose at range. The VEL 46 goes the other way. Its damage drops off sooner, though a higher damage floor softens the blow.

The APOC-338 has been one of the most popular LMGs since launch, so a small trim was expected. It is still a strong option. The TYPE 73 is now a more serious alternative, especially with its Apex attachment.

title: What are Kill Modes in Modern Warfare 4? Answered
content:
There are dozens of different challenges available to complete in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. From weapon Mastery Camos to daily challenges to Prestige challenges, there’s always something for you to be working towards in multiplayer and DMZ. However, if you opt to try and go for some of the calling card challenges in Modern Warfare 4, you’ll need to know what Kill Modes are.

You’re required to play “Kill Modes” for a variety of different calling card challenges in MW4, so here’s what they are and how to play them.

Fortunately, there’s a very simple explanation for what Kill Modes are in MW4. Plain and simple, they are game modes where the sole objective is to kill the enemy team. Any game mode with a side objective, such as collecting dog tags in Kill Confirmed, cash in Inflation, or capturing flags in Domination, isn’t considered a Kill Mode since score isn’t determined by kills alone.

As you might expect by now, there aren’t too many confirmed Kill Modes in MW4. However, the two Kill Modes are hugely popular, and they’re Team Deathmatch and Free-For-All . Playing either TDM or FFA in MW4 counts as playing a Kill Mode, so these modes will progress any challenge that requires that specific mode in multiplayer.

We recommend playing Team Deathmatch for most Kill Mode challenges, as you have easier opportunities to kill enemy players and there’s a team around you to help out with scorestreaks. However, if you want the most chances possible to kill enemies, then Free-For-All is the way to go, as no teammate can steal your potential kills.

In any case, you now have a guaranteed way to get kills while playing Kill Modes in Modern Warfare 4. With that out of the way, you can move on to completing other challenges, such as getting Longshot Kills or Point Blank Kills .

title: How to get Point Blank Kills in Modern Warfare 4
content:
There are some weapon camo challenges throughout Call of Duty history that give players the most trouble. In Modern Warfare 4 , several of these camo challenges have returned, including getting Point Blank Kills. These types of kills have long been a thorn in the side of camo grinders, but there are ways to make getting Point Blanks much easier in multiplayer.

Below, we’ll go through how to get Point Blank Kills and the best ways to go about doing so in Modern Warfare 4 multiplayer.

For starters, a Point Blank Kill is earned when you eliminate an enemy that is in extremely close proximity to you. It doesn’t matter when you damage an enemy, but when you see the kill pop up in the killfeed, you need to be within a certain range of the enemy for it to count as a Point Blank.

The exact range for a Point Blank Kill in Modern Warfare 4 is currently unknown, but we do know that it’s much closer than you might expect. In most cases, you need to be within roughly two meters of an enemy when you kill them to earn a Point Blank. This goes for all weapon classes as well, so unlike Longshot Kills , you have to be roughly two meters away even if you’re using something like a light machine gun or sniper rifle.

Now that you understand what a Point Blank Kill is, what’s the most optimal way to go about earning them in multiplayer? Well, it slightly depends on the gun you’re using, as some weapons are naturally stronger at closer ranges.

However, for the most part, you’ll want to use mobility attachments on your loadout so you can get your gun up quicker, which helps out tremendously when killing enemies at close-range. You could also go for an entirely hip-fire build and just shoot from the hip when killing enemies up close. This works best for most weapons, but you can ADS with something like an SMG or assault rifle and have the same results.

title: Fortnite Crew Changes December 5: More V-Bucks the Longer You Stay, No More Monthly Skins

title: Fortnite Pirate Shop Token Compass: Does it actually exist?
content:
Rumors in the Fortnite community suggest you can find a compass that helps you locate the ultra-rare Pirate Shop Token. Unfortunately, no such item exists in the game. It recently went viral because hundreds of thousands of players have spent countless hours searching for it.

This article outlines the compass’ origin and the latest updates regarding the mythical Pirate Shop Token.

As stated above, this rumored Fortnite compass doesn’t exist. It originated on TikTok, where creators claimed you can find it in-game and use it to locate a Chest containing the elusive Pirate Shop Token .

These videos usually depict a player with a compass displayed on-screen before they obtain the Pirate Shop Token. Several of these videos with similar images have surfaced since Epic Games released the Treasure Hunters season .

Many of these videos have generated hundreds of thousands of views, but they are all clickbait. One such post depicts a treasure-digging game where you can find the compass, and it will appear in your Fortnite locker.

title: How to ‘Complete a Loot Radio Tower Side Op’ in Modern Warfare 4 DMZ
content:
When you’re about halfway through the DMZ Orders in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 , you’ll encounter a task to “Complete a Loot Radio Tower Side Op.” While this sounds simple enough, you might quickly realize that there is no “Loot Radio Tower” mission on the map, so where do you go to complete the Side Op?

Fortunately, we managed to complete this specific Side Op in MW4 DMZ , and we’ll explain exactly how to finish this DMZ Order.

With previous DMZ Orders, all you’ve had to do for missions like this one is look on the map and find a green icon labeled with the mission you’re trying to complete. However, there is no Loot Radio Tower mission labeled on any icon on the map, no matter how hard you look.

Instead, you need to head to one single spot on the map to complete this particular Side Op. Specifically, you need to go to “C6” quadrant in Hajin, which is located north of Deadtown . Here, just east of a Fire Station, you’ll see a blue radio tower that has red smoke coming off the top of it. If you don’t see red smoke, then another player has beaten you to this Side Op, so you’ll have to enter a new match to attempt it again.

When you spot the smoking radio tower, the “Loot Radio Tower” icon will appear on your map, giving you the go-ahead to complete the mission. To start, you need to climb the radio tower, which requires much more parkour than you’re used to in DMZ. You have to jump to poles, climb up ladders, and carefully make your way up the tower until you reach the top.

Once you reach the top, all you have to do is interact with the crate at the top of the tower, and it will complete the Loot Radio Tower Side Op in DMZ. You can loot the crate, which sometimes has decent loot, and after that, the DMZ Order task will be complete, and you can move on to the next one in MW4.

title: Modern Warfare 4 Review Roundup: Players Love the Campaign, Hate the Lobbies
content:
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 has been on sale since 23 October, and the people playing it agree far more about one half of the game than the other. The campaign, which digital pre-order owners could start a week early on 16 October, has been welcomed as one of the best the series has produced. Multiplayer is a different conversation altogether, and most of the anger on Steam traces back to skill-based matchmaking, spawns and a launch map pool that few players are excited about.

We have not reviewed Modern Warfare 4 ourselves, so this roundup leans on what can be measured: Steam’s own review history, critic scores and the patch notes Infinity Ward has published since launch. The game costs $69.99 on Steam , or ₹4,999 in India, and it is out on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, PC and Nintendo Switch 2, with no version for PS4 or Xbox One. Infinity Ward leads development, while Beenox handled the PC version and Digital Legends built the Switch 2 edition , with Treyarch, Sledgehammer Games and Raven Software in support.

The Steam numbers show how quickly the mood changed. During the early access week, when only the story was playable, players left 5,238 positive reviews and 596 negative ones, so roughly nine in ten recommended it. Once multiplayer and DMZ opened on 23 October, however, the picture shifted. Since then the game has collected 3,137 positive and 2,244 negative reviews across all languages, a positive share of 58%, and the daily figure has stayed between roughly 48% and 64% the whole time. Across both periods it sits at 75% positive, while the English score on the store page reads Mostly Positive, with 73% of 5,738 reviews in favour as of 3 November.

That drop needs some context, though, because Modern Warfare 4 is still the best-received new Call of Duty on Steam in a long while. Its 73% among English reviews is ahead of Vanguard at 67%, Modern Warfare III at 46%, Modern Warfare II at 43%, Black Ops 6 at 42% and Black Ops 7 at 35%, and you have to go back to Black Ops III in 2015, which now sits at 90%, to find a yearly release that scores higher on the same store. Critics have been kinder still, with Metacritic listing the game at 85 overall, the PC version at 85, PS5 at 83 and Switch 2 at 86. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma went as far as calling it “one of the most celebrated Call of Duty games in its 24-year history” when she announced that the series had passed $40 billion in lifetime revenue .

Modern Warfare 4 closes out the rebooted Modern Warfare series that began in 2019, and it opens with North Korea invading the South. Much of the early story follows Private Park Hyun-jun, a young South Korean soldier whose squad is trying to hold the city of Hajin, while a second thread picks up where Modern Warfare III left off. Task Force 141 has broken up and Captain Price is on the run, with Ghost and Gaz under orders to bring him in. Price, meanwhile, is working off the books alongside Valeria Garza of the Las Almas Cartel, chasing a weapon on its way to a villain known as the Archer, played by Mads Mikkelsen, and CIA station chief Kate Laswell is still in touch with him.

Over 16 missions the story travels from Hajin to a New York nightclub, a car chase through Paris and a night raid in Mumbai, where Price and Gaz split into two teams. Mumbai later returns as one of the 12 core multiplayer maps, and one early mission even puts players in the boots of a North Korean soldier hunting a defector. Most players say they finished on Normal in six to eight hours, and anyone who beats it on Realism unlocks YOLO mode , a one-life difficulty that sends you back to the first mission the moment you die.

The Fortnite Pirate Shop Token is an extremely rare reward in the Fortnite Treasure Hunters mini season. The mini season launched on November 1, 2026, with update v43.00. It bridges Chapter 7 Season 4 and Chapter 8.

title: RLCS : Geekay mise sur un roster français avec Seikoo, juicy et mtzr (off.)
content:
Le mercato Rocket League continue de redistribuer les cartes au sommet de la scène européenne. Après les annonces de Gentle Mates, Vitality et de la Karmine Corp, Geekay Esports a dévoilé son nouvel effectif pour les RLCS 2027, composé d’Enzo « Seikoo » Grondein, Charles « juicy » Sabiani et Mathis « mtzr » Hoareau. Deux recrues particulièrement expérimentées qui rejoignent l’un des jeunes talents prometteurs de la scène française. L’objectif est clair : construire un projet capable de rivaliser avec les meilleures formations européennes, malgré une concurrence qui s’annonce particulièrement relevée.

Juicy arrive en provenance de la Karmine Corp, avec laquelle il a notamment remporté le Paris Major en 2026, tandis que Seikoo quitte Manchester City. Les deux Français avaient rapidement décidé de s’associer durant cette intersaison et envisageaient initialement de jouer avec M0nkey M00n. Mais le double champion du monde a finalement choisi de rejoindre la reconstruction de la KC, laissant une place disponible dans le trio. Geekay a alors saisi l’occasion pour réunir les deux joueurs autour de mtzr, qui poursuit sa progression après deux saisons de développement au plus haut niveau.

Autre annonce importante, Andy « Kassio » Landais fait son retour sur le circuit RLCS. L’ancien joueur professionnel, passé par les staffs de BDS et Vitality, avait décidé de prendre sa retraite d’entraîneur en 2025. Après une expérience auprès de la sélection marocaine dans le cadre de la FIFAe World Cup 2026, finalement reportée, le Français de 25 ans a choisi de retrouver la compétition. Il explique notamment avoir renoué avec sa passion pour Rocket League, une motivation qui l’a convaincu d’accepter ce nouveau défi.

Malgré ce recrutement ambitieux, Geekay Esports devra passer par les qualifications ouvertes européennes pour espérer participer au Club Kick-Off de Londres, prévu en décembre. Contrairement à plusieurs de ses concurrents, la structure n’a pas été retenue parmi les organisations partenaires du RLCS Club Championship 2027. Le nouveau trio français fera toutefois ses premiers pas en compétition dès le 2 novembre à l’occasion de la Coupe de France Slash 2026, où il pourrait notamment croiser la route de Gentle Mates, Vitality et la Karmine Corp. Un premier test intéressant pour une équipe qui espère rapidement bousculer la hiérarchie européenne.

title: Vico Opens Up About Mental Health Struggles After Career-Best Fortnite Year
content:
BIG’s Taylor-Petrik “vic0” Gatschelhofer, known to most fans as Vico, has opened up about years of mental health struggles, five weeks after finishing third at the FNCS Global Championship and stepping away from competitive Fortnite. In posts on X on Sunday, he said he attempted to take his own life shortly before Globals, and that he no longer has contact with his family.

Vico’s 2026 run with Malibuca is why BIG called them “the best duo of all time” after Globals. They won the FNCS Major 1 Summit in Düsseldorf , then took the inaugural Fortnite Reload Elite Series at the Esports World Cup 2026.

Globals, at the Lotto Arena in Antwerp from 24 to 27 September, nearly made it three. The BIG pair led by 32 points going into the final game and finished third , four points behind champions SwizzY and Pixie, for $160,000 from the $2,000,000 prize pool. Our Globals grand finals report covers how that last game unfolded.

BIG’s chief gaming officer, Roman Reinhardt, summed up the result at the time: “Third place at Fortnite Globals. So close, but that’s part of it and it stings. Not everyone can say they were one kill away from the Globals win.” He added a line aimed at his players: “We believe in you 100%.” The club’s own post on X put it more simply: “No third trophy but still a great result.”

In October, BIG announced that Vico was one of ten finalists for Esports PC Player of the Year at the Esports Awards 2026, with the winners due to be revealed in Miami on 17 November. “Vico has had an incredible year, and his journey is truly special,” Reinhardt said then. Vico called the nomination “a huge honour”.

The first sign that something was wrong came on the final day of Globals. Vico said he had almost not attended the event, a comment picked up and shared by community accounts within hours. That evening he announced a break on X : “will be taking a break from competetive fortnite for a while. dealing with a lot of private stuff outside my competetive carreer and want to focus on that first and figure my life out. Will be back next year.”

title: RLCS : Vitality frappe fort avec nass, Oski et diaz (off.)
content:
C’est une nouvelle ère qui s’ouvre chez Team Vitality. Après une saison 2026 marquée par plusieurs belles performances, mais aussi de nombreuses désillusions, la Ruche a choisi de renouveler intégralement son effectif Rocket League. Le départ d’Alexis « zen » Bernier vers Gentle Mates, où il évoluera aux côtés de Vatira et Atow, avait lancé les grandes manœuvres. Brice « ExoTiiK » Bigeard et Gaspar « stizzy » Rosalén ont également quitté l’organisation, mettant un terme à une aventure qui n’aura pas permis à Vitality de retrouver les sommets mondiaux.

Pour leur succéder, Vitality a officialisé les arrivées de Nassim « nass » Bali, Oskar « Oski » Gozdowski et du Brésilien diaz. Les deux premiers débarquent directement de Gentle Mates, effectuant ainsi le chemin inverse de zen, tandis que diaz arrive en provenance de Spacestation Gaming. Un recrutement ambitieux qui permet à la structure française de réunir trois joueurs au profil offensif, capables de rivaliser avec les meilleures équipes du circuit. Benjamin « Eversax » Wagner, lui, conserve son poste d’entraîneur et sera chargé de trouver rapidement les automatismes nécessaires à ce nouveau trio.

Cette reconstruction intervient après un exercice 2026 contrasté. Vitality avait pourtant atteint la finale du Boston Major, finalement perdue face à Gentle Mates (2-4), avant de remporter deux tournois régionaux européens. Mais les performances irrégulières et les éliminations répétées face aux principaux concurrents ont progressivement fragilisé le projet. Au Paris Major, la Ruche avait notamment échoué aux portes de la finale après une défaite particulièrement serrée contre la Karmine Corp (3-4).

Avec nass, Oski et diaz, Vitality espère désormais retrouver une place parmi les références internationales de Rocket League. Ce mercato redistribue également les cartes au sommet de la scène européenne, alors que Gentle Mates a constitué un trio particulièrement impressionnant autour de zen, Vatira et Atow. Les premiers tournois régionaux des RLCS 2027 permettront de mesurer le potentiel de cette nouvelle formation, avec un objectif évident pour la Ruche : transformer ce grand remaniement en titres majeurs.

title: RLCS : Gentle Mates officialise son trio de rêve avec zen, Vatira et Atow
content:
Le feuilleton de l’intersaison touche enfin à sa fin. Ce mercredi soir, Gentle Mates a officialisé le recrutement d’Alexis « zen » Bernier, Axel « Vatira » Touret et Tristan « Atow » Soyez, donnant naissance à une véritable super-équipe francophone. Un trio dont l’association faisait rêver une partie de la communauté depuis plusieurs mois, mais dont la concrétisation était loin d’être acquise. Gentle Mates a dû livrer une bataille particulièrement intense face à la Karmine Corp et Vitality, également déterminées à attirer ces trois stars. Les négociations auraient été marquées par une importante surenchère et plusieurs tensions en coulisses, avant que le club fondé par Squeezie, Brawks et Gotaga ne parvienne à convaincre les joueurs.

LES 3 MONSTRES SONT ENFIN RÉUNIS ! Souhaitez la bienvenue à notre roster Rocket League #M8WIN pic.twitter.com/LAvvqCw2a6

Ce transfert marque également la fin de deux aventures emblématiques du Rocket League français. Arrivé chez Vitality en 2023, zen avait immédiatement bouleversé la hiérarchie mondiale, remportant les Championnats du monde dès sa première saison professionnelle. De son côté, Vatira quitte la Karmine Corp après quatre années durant lesquelles il est devenu le véritable visage de la section Rocket League, avec notamment trois Majors remportés. Atow, son coéquipier depuis 2024, apporte lui aussi une immense expérience du très haut niveau, après avoir notamment remporté l’Esports World Cup 2025 sous les couleurs de la KC.

Sur le papier, Gentle Mates possède désormais l’un des effectifs les plus impressionnants de l’histoire de Rocket League. Les trois joueurs, déjà habitués à évoluer ensemble ou à se retrouver sur les plus grandes scènes internationales, devront toutefois transformer cette accumulation de talents en résultats. Car les attentes seront immenses autour d’une formation qui ne pourra raisonnablement viser autre chose que les plus grands trophées.

La concurrence s’annonce d’ailleurs particulièrement relevée en France. Dans la foulée de ces départs, la Karmine Corp a officialisé son nouveau projet autour de M0nkey M00n, bibbaba et reyyn, avec Extra toujours aux commandes. Vitality, de son côté, restera également engagée sur le circuit RLCS malgré le départ de sa star. Trois structures françaises, des effectifs profondément remaniés et une rivalité qui promet de faire des étincelles : la prochaine saison, dont le coup d’envoi est prévu à la mi-novembre, s’annonce déjà passionnante.

title: Test Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 sur PS5 : un retour aux fondamentaux qui fait du bien
content:
Chaque année, la sortie d’un nouveau Call of Duty suscite son lot d’attentes, de débats et de comparaisons avec les épisodes précédents. La série a beau rester une référence du FPS grand public, elle n’a pas toujours réussi à renouveler sa formule sans perdre une partie de son identité. Entre les déplacements toujours plus spectaculaires, les approches parfois très éloignées du champ de bataille traditionnel et les propositions qui privilégient la surenchère, j’avais parfois eu l’impression que la franchise cherchait davantage à se réinventer qu’à perfectionner ce qu’elle savait déjà faire. Avec Modern Warfare 4, Infinity Ward semble avoir pris une direction différente : revenir à un cadre militaire contemporain, à des affrontements plus lisibles et à une action nerveuse, sans pour autant renoncer aux sensations qui ont fait le succès de la licence.

Dès mes premières parties, j’ai apprécié cette volonté de retrouver un équilibre entre efficacité arcade et crédibilité visuelle. Les soldats restent rapides, les fusillades conservent leur intensité et les affrontements peuvent basculer en quelques secondes, mais les mouvements paraissent un peu plus mesurés. Les armes ont du poids, les déplacements gagnent en cohérence et les différentes possibilités offertes sur le terrain enrichissent les combats sans transformer chaque rencontre en concours de figures acrobatiques. Le résultat n’a rien d’un simulateur militaire pur et dur, et ce n’est d’ailleurs pas ce que je lui demande. Modern Warfare 4 cherche plutôt à proposer un FPS accessible, réactif et spectaculaire, avec une identité militaire suffisamment affirmée pour se distinguer de certaines orientations plus exubérantes de la série.

Cette direction constitue à mes yeux l’une des grandes réussites de cet épisode. Le jeu ne bouleverse pas tout ce que l’on connaît de Call of Duty, mais il retravaille plusieurs éléments importants pour donner davantage de cohérence à l’ensemble. Surtout, il ne repose pas uniquement sur sa campagne pour convaincre : entre le solo, le multijoueur classique et DMZ, j’ai découvert trois expériences qui partagent les mêmes fondations tout en proposant des objectifs et des sensations suffisamment différents. Cette générosité donne à Modern Warfare 4 une vraie valeur sur la durée et explique en grande partie mon enthousiasme.

C’est par sa campagne que Modern Warfare 4 cherche d’abord à marquer les esprits, et je dois reconnaître qu’Infinity Ward a plutôt bien préparé son retour. L’aventure nous entraîne au cœur d’un conflit international impliquant notamment les deux Corées et la Russie, avec des opérations qui nous conduisent dans plusieurs grandes villes et zones de combat. De Séoul à New York, en passant par d’autres environnements urbains particulièrement soignés, le jeu multiplie les changements de décor et les situations pour éviter que l’histoire ne s’enferme dans une succession de fusillades interchangeables.

La campagne adopte surtout une approche narrative intéressante en alternant plusieurs points de vue. D’un côté, nous découvrons le conflit à travers des soldats sud-coréens, parfois encore novices, qui se retrouvent plongés dans une guerre dépassant largement leur expérience. De l’autre, Captain Price suit une trajectoire plus personnelle, guidée par une volonté de vengeance qui l’amène à remettre en question certains principes ayant longtemps défini le personnage. Cette opposition entre des combattants confrontés brutalement à la réalité du terrain et un opérateur chevronné engagé dans une affaire intime donne au récit une dimension plus humaine qu’une simple succession de missions héroïques.

J’ai particulièrement apprécié les séquences qui prennent le temps de montrer les conséquences du conflit sur les populations civiles. Modern Warfare 4 ne se contente pas d’aligner des explosions et des interventions spectaculaires : il cherche aussi à faire ressentir la violence d’une guerre qui ne touche pas uniquement les soldats présents sur le front. Certaines missions, notamment du côté nord-coréen, adoptent un ton plus sombre et mettent en scène des situations difficiles, qui contrastent efficacement avec les opérations plus classiques menées par des unités d’élite. Cette diversité de points de vue permet de renouveler l’approche du récit et donne parfois aux événements une intensité qui dépasse le simple plaisir de l’action.

title: RLCS : la Karmine Corp officialise les départs de Vatira, Atow et juicy
content:
La Karmine Corp repart de zéro, ou presque. Dans un message publié ce mardi sur ses réseaux sociaux, le club français a confirmé les départs d’Axel « Vatira » Touret, Tristan « Atow » Soyez et Charles « juicy » Sabiani, mettant fin à l’aventure d’un trio qui aura marqué la saison 2026 des RLCS. Ensemble, les trois joueurs avaient notamment remporté le Major de Paris face à Twisted Minds, avant de terminer dans le dernier carré des Championnats du monde. Un bilan prestigieux, mais insuffisant pour prolonger leur collaboration une saison supplémentaire.

Le départ le plus symbolique reste évidemment celui de Vatira, véritable visage de la Karmine Corp sur Rocket League depuis quatre ans. Atow quitte également le club après trois saisons, au cours desquelles il a remporté trois titres internationaux en LAN aux côtés de son compatriote, ainsi que l’Esports World Cup 2025. Les deux Français devraient désormais rejoindre Gentle Mates pour former un trio exceptionnel avec Alexis « zen » Bernier. De son côté, juicy, arrivé il y a seulement un an, est attendu chez Geekay Esports aux côtés de Seikoo et mtzr.

Si les trois joueurs quittent officiellement le navire, la Karmine Corp ne compte pas pour autant revoir ses ambitions à la baisse. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , Evan « M0nkey M00n » Rogez devrait devenir la nouvelle tête d’affiche du projet, accompagné des jeunes Attila « bibbaba » Eötvös et reyyn. Un trio mêlant expérience et jeunesse, avec deux joueurs de 16 ans particulièrement prometteurs.

Sur le banc, Alexandre « Extra » Paoli devrait conserver son poste d’entraîneur malgré l’intérêt de Gentle Mates. Il retrouverait ainsi M0nkey M00n, son ancien coéquipier avec lequel il avait remporté les Championnats du monde 2021-2022 sous les couleurs de BDS. Des retrouvailles qui pourraient marquer le début d’un nouveau chapitre ambitieux pour la KC, attendue dès décembre pour le RLCS Club Championship. Après les adieux à trois figures majeures de son histoire récente, le Blue Wall s’apprête à découvrir un tout nouveau visage.

title: RLCS : AcroniK prend sa retraite à seulement 21 ans
content:
Une page se tourne sur la scène européenne de Rocket League. Bruno Alexandre « AcroniK » dos Santos Lopes a officialisé sa retraite sportive à seulement 21 ans, dans un court message publié sur les réseaux sociaux. « Je sais que ce ne sont pas les meilleurs mots pour annoncer une retraite, mais honnêtement, je n’ai pas envie d’écrire un long texte pour dire que j’arrête. Merci à tous. On se retrouve pour le prochain chapitre ! » , a confié le Portugais, sans donner davantage de détails sur ses futurs projets.

C’est surtout sous les couleurs de Team Liquid qu’AcroniK s’est fait un nom, en accompagnant l’éclosion de deux jeunes prodiges : Tristan « Atow » Soyez et Oskar « Oski » Gozdowski. Recrutés en février 2022 alors qu’ils n’avaient que 14 ans, les deux joueurs ont rapidement formé avec lui l’un des trios les plus redoutables d’Europe. Ensemble, ils ont remporté deux tournois régionaux, participé à cinq LAN internationales et atteint le dernier carré des Worlds 2023. Une aventure qui reste aujourd’hui le sommet de la carrière du Portugais, considéré comme le joueur le plus accompli de son pays sur Rocket League.

Après la séparation du trio en 2023, AcroniK n’a jamais vraiment retrouvé les mêmes résultats. Il s’est néanmoins illustré chez Luna Galaxy, avec notamment une deuxième place lors d’un tournoi régional des RLCS 2024, après une courte défaite face à BDS (3-4). Plus récemment, il avait rejoint NOVO Esports pour la saison 2026, disputant plusieurs tournois régionaux avant de représenter le Portugal aux championnats continentaux FIFAe, où sa sélection a atteint le top 8.

AcroniK quitte ainsi la scène professionnelle après sept années de compétition et six LAN des RLCS disputées au total. Il rejoint une liste de joueurs ayant récemment annoncé leur retraite, parmi lesquels ApparentlyJack, Comm, Stake et LuiisP. Si son palmarès ne reflète pas forcément toute son influence, le Portugais laisse derrière lui un héritage important, notamment pour son rôle dans l’éclosion d’Atow et Oski, aujourd’hui encore présents au plus haut niveau.

With that, I know it’s not the best words for retirement but tbh I don’t want to write a big text to say that I’m retiring. Thank you all. See you in my next chapter! https://t.co/ntRmN1deuq

title: RLCS : Extra reste fidèle à la Karmine Corp, le retour d’un duo légendaire
content:
La reconstruction de la Karmine Corp sur Rocket League prend forme. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , Alexandre « Extra » Paoli devrait conserver son poste d’entraîneur principal pour la saison RLCS 2027. Un choix important pour l’organisation française, contrainte de revoir entièrement ses plans après les départs attendus d’Atow et Vatira vers Gentle Mates. Extra avait lui-même discuté avec cette dernière structure pour suivre ses anciens joueurs, avant de finalement privilégier la continuité avec la KC.

Arrivé à la Karmine Corp après avoir pris sa retraite de joueur en 2025, le Français de 24 ans sort d’une première saison réussie sur le banc. Sous sa direction, la KC a notamment remporté le Major de Paris et atteint le dernier carré des Worlds 2026. Mais son maintien prend une dimension particulière avec l’arrivée attendue d’Evan « M0nkey M00n » Rogez, son ancien coéquipier chez Team BDS. Ensemble, les deux Français avaient remporté les Worlds RLCS 2021-2022, avant de marquer durablement l’histoire de la scène compétitive. Ils pourraient désormais se retrouver dans une configuration inédite, avec Extra dans le rôle d’entraîneur et M0nkey M00n comme leader sur le terrain.

Après avoir envisagé un retrait de Rocket League durant l’intersaison, la Karmine Corp aurait finalement choisi de miser sur un mélange d’expérience et de jeunesse. M0nkey M00n devrait être accompagné d’Attila « bibbaba » Eötvös et de reyyn, deux joueurs de seulement 16 ans, encore peu expérimentés au plus haut niveau. Un pari ambitieux, mais qui permettrait aux deux espoirs d’évoluer aux côtés d’un double champion du monde, sous les ordres d’un entraîneur qui connaît parfaitement son jeu.

Cette nouvelle équipe aurait pour mission de tourner la page d’un effectif historique, également marqué par le départ attendu de juicy vers Geekay Esports. La KC devrait faire ses premiers pas avec ce trio lors du RLCS Kick-Off de Londres en décembre, une compétition à laquelle elle est invitée en tant qu’organisation partenaire. Après une intersaison mouvementée, le club français semble donc avoir trouvé les bases de son nouveau projet, avec des ambitions à reconstruire autour du duo Extra – M0nkey M00n.

title: Razer controllers will power Rocket League student finals at FUSE Esports Festival
content:
Student finalists in the State and National Rocket League Finals will play on high-end Razer controllers used by professional players this November, after the hardware brand became the Official Controller Partner of Australian school esports operator The FUSE Cup. The Rocket League decider is the capstone of a school year of qualifiers.

The FUSE Cup's Chief Operating Officer, Daniel Aivaliotis-Martinez, shared the news in an announcement post on LinkedIn , which he used to speak about creating meaningful experiences for young people before thanking the Razer team for their support and belief in what the FUSE Cup is building. Razer gear, which is used by esports pros around the world, as well as actual world champions, will now be in the hands of every finalist competing for the national title.

The controllers themselves come with 2.4GHz wireless technology that prevents lag, toggleable physical triggers and back paddles.

The partnership has two parts: finalists get Razer controllers for the State and National Rocket League Finals, which means players won’t have to bring their own pads to the biggest series of their school careers.

Secondly, Razer is sponsoring the Student Leadership Award, a new category at the FUSE Australian School Esports Awards. It's aimed at pupils who make a positive contribution to their community and show leadership inside their school's esports program. It means the brand is also putting itself on a prize that has nothing to do with winning matches.

The FUSE Esports Festival sees itself as Australia's largest in-person school esports festival. It’s backed by the City of Gold Coast council, and it takes place at Southern Cross University.

title: How to Get the Beetlejuice Skin in Fortnite: Price, Bundle and Release Date
content:
You can get the Beetlejuice skin in Fortnite by buying it from the Item Shop for 1,500 V-Bucks, or by picking up the full Beetlejuice Bundle for 2,400 V-Bucks. The set arrived on October 23, 2026 at 5 PM PT (5:30 AM IST on October 24) as part of Fortnitemares 2026. There is no free version and no quest that unlocks it.

Here is what each option includes, how much the bundle really saves you and how long the set should stay in the shop.

The Beetlejuice outfit costs 1,500 V-Bucks on its own, and that offer also includes the Beetlejuice’s Marquee back bling. The full bundle costs 2,400 V-Bucks. Epic’s official Beetlejuice Bundle listing puts the regular value of everything inside at 5,300 V-Bucks, so the bundle knocks 2,900 V-Bucks off.

The bundle covers the whole set. According to Epic’s shop listing, it includes:

The outfit is an Epic-rarity skin, and its in-game description is a nod to the films: “Say his name three times.” The sandworm items reference the striped creature from the films, and the marquee pieces spell out the character’s name in a flashing sign.

By our math, the bundle costs 900 V-Bucks more than the outfit on its own and adds six more items: the pickaxe, guitar, kicks, wrap and both emotes. Measured against the 5,300 V-Bucks regular value, the bundle discount works out to about 55%. If you only care about the skin, the 1,500 V-Bucks offer is enough. If you want the extras too, the bundle is the better deal by a wide margin, since those six items carry a regular value of 3,800 V-Bucks and you pay only 900 more for them.

title: La Coupe de France Slash est de retour sur Rocket League
content:
La Coupe de France Slash de Rocket League s’apprête à faire son grand retour pour une deuxième édition. Après avoir attiré 1,8 million de vues en direct cumulées en 2025, l’événement renouvelle son partenariat avec France Télévisions et sa plateforme Slash. L’an dernier, Gentle Mates avait remporté le trophée face à la Karmine Corp lors de la finale organisée à la Paris Games Week. Cette fois, la compétition se déroulera entièrement en ligne et permettra aux nouvelles compositions de se mesurer avant la reprise du circuit professionnel.

Le tournoi se tiendra du 28 octobre au 12 novembre, avec une diffusion exclusive des phases de poule du 2 au 11 novembre, avant les demi-finales et la grande finale programmées le 12 novembre. L’ensemble des rencontres sera accessible gratuitement sur les chaînes Twitch et YouTube de Slash, ainsi que sur ses comptes X et TikTok. Les commentaires seront assurés par RocketBaguette, collectif incontournable de la scène francophone Rocket League.

Avec cette deuxième édition, France Télévisions confirme sa volonté de renforcer la visibilité de l’esport auprès du grand public. La Coupe de France Slash constituera également un premier rendez-vous intéressant pour observer les nouveaux effectifs de la scène française, dans un mercato particulièrement mouvementé à l’approche des RLCS 2027.
